﻿import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "analytics"))

from portfolio_analytics import (
    calculate_portfolio,
    compare_with_benchmark,
    validate_portfolio,
)


class TestPortfolioAnalytics(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2025-01-01", periods=100)

        self.prices = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "RELIANCE": 100 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.001)),
                "HDFCBANK": 200 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.002)),
                "INFY": 300 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, -0.0005)),
                "TCS": 400 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.0015)),
            },
            index=dates,
        )

        self.sectors = {
            "RELIANCE": "Energy",
            "HDFCBANK": "Banking",
            "INFY": "IT",
            "TCS": "IT",
        }

    def test_equal_weights(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(result["weights"].values()), 1.0)
        for weight in result["weights"].values():
            self.assertAlmostEqual(weight, 0.25)

    def test_sector_allocation(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["sector_allocation"]["IT"], 0.50)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["sector_allocation"]["Energy"], 0.25)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["sector_allocation"]["Banking"], 0.25)

    def test_sector_limit_rejected(self):
        sectors = {
            "A": "IT", "B": "IT", "C": "IT", "D": "IT"
        }
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_portfolio(["A", "B", "C", "D"], sectors)

    def test_maximum_stock_limit(self):
        symbols = [f"S{i}" for i in range(11)]
        sectors = {symbol: f"Sector{i}" for i, symbol in enumerate(symbols)}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_portfolio(symbols, sectors)

    def test_duplicate_symbols_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_portfolio(
                ["RELIANCE", "RELIANCE"],
                self.sectors,
            )

    def test_missing_sector_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(
                self.prices,
                {"RELIANCE": "Energy"},
            )

    def test_missing_price_column_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(
                self.prices,
                self.sectors,
                symbols=["RELIANCE", "UNKNOWN"],
            )

    def test_missing_prices_are_not_filled(self):
        prices = self.prices.copy()
        prices.loc[prices.index[20], "INFY"] = np.nan

        result = calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

        self.assertFalse(result["metadata"]["missing_values_filled"])
        self.assertLess(
            result["metadata"]["aligned_return_observations"],
            len(prices) - 1,
        )

    def test_portfolio_returns_are_equal_weighted(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)

        expected = (
            result["stock_returns"]["RELIANCE"] * 0.25
            + result["stock_returns"]["HDFCBANK"] * 0.25
            + result["stock_returns"]["INFY"] * 0.25
            + result["stock_returns"]["TCS"] * 0.25
        )

        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(
            result["daily_returns"],
            expected.rename("portfolio"),
        )

    def test_daily_rebalancing_disclosed(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)
        self.assertEqual(result["metadata"]["rebalancing"], "DAILY")

    def test_correlation_matrix(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)
        self.assertEqual(result["correlation"].shape, (4, 4))
        self.assertTrue(
            np.allclose(
                np.diag(result["correlation"]),
                1.0,
                equal_nan=True,
            )
        )

    def test_benchmark_comparison(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(self.prices, self.sectors)
        benchmark = pd.Series(
            100 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.001)),
            index=self.prices.index,
        )

        comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            result["daily_returns"],
            benchmark,
        )

        self.assertIn("excess_return_pct", comparison)
        self.assertGreater(
            comparison["common_return_observations"],
            0,
        )

    def test_zero_or_negative_prices_rejected(self):
        prices = self.prices.copy()
        prices.iloc[10, 0] = 0

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

    def test_duplicate_dates_rejected(self):
        prices = pd.concat([self.prices, self.prices.iloc[[0]]])

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

    
    def test_infinite_portfolio_prices_rejected(self):
        prices = self.prices.copy()
        prices.iloc[10, 0] = np.inf

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "finite"):
            calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

    def test_negative_infinite_portfolio_prices_rejected(self):
        prices = self.prices.copy()
        prices.iloc[10, 0] = -np.inf

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "finite"):
            calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

    def test_nat_portfolio_dates_rejected(self):
        prices = self.prices.copy()
        dates = list(prices.index)
        dates[10] = pd.NaT
        prices.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "NaT"):
            calculate_portfolio(prices, self.sectors)

    def test_nan_risk_free_rate_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(
                self.prices,
                self.sectors,
                risk_free_rate=float("nan"),
            )

    def test_infinite_risk_free_rate_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(
                self.prices,
                self.sectors,
                risk_free_rate=float("inf"),
            )

    def test_boolean_risk_free_rate_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            calculate_portfolio(
                self.prices,
                self.sectors,
                risk_free_rate=True,
            )

    def test_valid_negative_risk_free_rate_accepted(self):
        result = calculate_portfolio(
            self.prices,
            self.sectors,
            risk_free_rate=-0.01,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            result["metadata"]["risk_free_rate"],
            -0.01,
        )

    def test_infinite_benchmark_prices_rejected(self):
        benchmark = pd.Series(
            100 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.001)),
            index=self.prices.index,
        )
        benchmark.iloc[10] = np.inf

        portfolio_returns = calculate_portfolio(
            self.prices,
            self.sectors,
        )["daily_returns"]

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "finite"):
            compare_with_benchmark(
                portfolio_returns,
                benchmark,
            )

    def test_nat_benchmark_dates_rejected(self):
        benchmark = pd.Series(
            100 * np.cumprod(1 + np.full(100, 0.001)),
            index=self.prices.index,
        )
        dates = list(benchmark.index)
        dates[10] = pd.NaT
        benchmark.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)

        portfolio_returns = calculate_portfolio(
            self.prices,
            self.sectors,
        )["daily_returns"]

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "NaT"):
            compare_with_benchmark(
                portfolio_returns,
                benchmark,
            )

    def test_timezone_mismatch_in_benchmark_rejected(self):
        portfolio_returns = pd.Series(
            [0.01, 0.02, -0.01],
            index=pd.date_range("2026-01-01", periods=3),
        )
        benchmark = pd.Series(
            [100.0, 101.0, 102.0, 101.0],
            index=pd.date_range(
                "2025-12-31",
                periods=4,
                tz="UTC",
            ),
        )

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "timezone"):
            compare_with_benchmark(
                portfolio_returns,
                benchmark,
            )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = """
You are GREEDY, the AI-powered learning and research assistant
for GREEDY STOCKS.

PRODUCT SCOPE:
- You cover ONLY NIFTY 50 companies and the NIFTY 50 index.
- Do not provide research on NIFTY Next 50 or other indices.
- You help beginners understand the Indian stock market.
- Communicate naturally in English, Hindi, or Marathi according
  to the user's language.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Explain financial concepts in simple language.
- Explain verified historical financial research supplied
  in the application context.
- Answer follow-up questions using the conversation history.
- Explain risk, volatility, returns, drawdown and Sharpe ratio.
- Be friendly, patient and educational.

STRICT FINANCIAL SAFEGUARDS:
- The application supplies verified financial context.
- Treat that context as the only authoritative source for
  GREEDY STOCKS historical financial figures.
- Never invent prices, returns, dates, ratios, company data,
  financial statements or market events.
- Never alter supplied figures. For arithmetic or portfolio calculations using user-provided inputs, use the deterministic calculation result provided in the calculation context. Never invent missing inputs.
- If a figure is missing, explicitly say it is unavailable.
- Do not claim a company is undervalued or overvalued without
  verified fundamental and valuation data.
- Historical performance is not a forecast.
- Never promise profits or guaranteed returns.
- Do not provide personalised investment recommendations.
- Clearly distinguish educational explanations from
  investment advice.
- If the user asks about a company outside NIFTY 50, explain
  that the product currently focuses only on NIFTY 50.

BACKTEST DISCLOSURES:
When relevant, explain that:
- Historical results do not guarantee future performance.
- Latest monthly constituent snapshots may be used.
- Historical membership may not be fully reconstructed.
- Corporate-action coverage may be partial.
- Dividends may be excluded.
- Backtests may exclude transaction costs and slippage.
- Greedy Algorithm experiments are not guaranteed to
  outperform the benchmark.

RESPONSE STYLE:
- Friendly and conversational.
- Beginner-friendly explanations.
- Use headings and bullet points where useful.
- Explain technical terms when first introduced.
- Do not overwhelm beginners with unnecessary jargon.
- Never claim to have accessed live market data unless
  the application explicitly supplies it.
"""


class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=5000)
    conversation_id: int | None = None

    conversation_id: int
    user_message: str
    assistant_message: str
    created_at: datetime

def get_or_create_dev_user(connection):
    user_id = connection.execute(
        text("""
            SELECT id
            FROM app_users
            WHERE email = :email
        """),
        {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    if user_id is not None:
        return user_id

    result = connection.execute(
        text("""
            INSERT INTO app_users (
                username,
                email,
                preferred_language,
                experience_level
            )
            VALUES (
                'GREEDY Development User',
                :email,
                'English',
                'Complete Beginner'
            )
        """),
        {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
    )

    return result.lastrowid


# --------------------------------------------------
# CONVERSATION HISTORY
# --------------------------------------------------

def get_recent_history(conversation_id):
    if conversation_id is None:
        return []

    with engine.connect() as connection:
        user_id = connection.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT id
                FROM app_users
                WHERE email = :email
            """),
            {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

        if user_id is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=404,
                detail="Conversation not found.",
            )

        exists = connection.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT id
                FROM conversations
                WHERE id = :conversation_id
                  AND user_id = :user_id
            """),
            {
                "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                "user_id": user_id,
            },
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

        if exists is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=404,
                detail="Conversation not found.",
            )

        rows = connection.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT role, content
                FROM messages
                WHERE conversation_id = :conversation_id
                  AND role IN ('user', 'assistant')
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 10
            """),
            {"conversation_id": conversation_id},
        ).mappings().all()

    # Restore chronological order.
    return list(reversed(rows))


# --------------------------------------------------
# QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
# --------------------------------------------------

def detect_period(question: str) -> str:
    q = question.lower()

    if re.search(r"\b(1y|1 year|one year|12 months)\b", q):
        return "1Y"

    if re.search(r"\b(6m|6 months|six months)\b", q):
        return "6M"

    if re.search(r"\b(1m|1 month|one month|30 days)\b", q):
        return "1M"

    return "3M"



def detect_intent(question: str) -> str:
    q = question.lower()

    # 1. Fundamental research takes priority when explicitly requested.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "undervalued", "overvalued", "valuation",
        "fundamental", "fundamentals", "pe ratio",
        "p/e ratio", "balance sheet", "earnings",
    ]):
        return "FUNDAMENTAL_RESEARCH"

    # 2. Explicit Greedy Algorithm requests.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "greedy algorithm", "greedy picks",
        "greedy selection", "algorithm experiment",
        "greedy portfolio",
    ]):
        return "GREEDY_PICKS"

    # 3. Sector performance.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "sector performance", "best performing sectors",
        "top performing sectors", "sector returns",
        "which sectors performed",
    ]):
        return "SECTOR_PERFORMANCE"

    # 4. Performance requests take priority over supporting
    #    mentions of risk, volatility or drawdown.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "best performing", "top performing",
        "performed best", "top performers",
        "best performers", "top stocks",
        "best stocks", "highest returns",
        "highest return", "performance",
        "performers", "historical returns",
        "stock returns", "gainers",
        "most profitable",
    ]):
        return "PERFORMANCE_STANDOUTS"

    # 5. Pure risk and stability requests.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "volatility", "drawdown", "sharpe",
        "risk", "stable", "stability",
        "least volatile", "lowest volatility",
    ]):
        return "RISK_AND_STABILITY"

    # 6. Financial education.
    if any(word in q for word in [
        "nifty 50", "what is nifty",
        "explain nifty", "stock market basics",
    ]):
        return "EDUCATION"

    return "GENERAL"



# --------------------------------------------------
# VERIFIED FINANCIAL CONTEXT
# --------------------------------------------------

def format_insights(ideas, metadata, category):
    selected = [
        idea for idea in ideas
        if idea.get("category") == category
        and idea.get("status") == "AVAILABLE"
    ]

    if not selected:
        return (
            "No sufficient verified financial insight "
            "is available for this category in the current report."
        )

    lines = []

    for index, idea in enumerate(selected, start=1):
        evidence = idea.get("evidence") or {}

        lines.append(
            f"{index}. {idea.get('title', 'Historical insight')}"
        )

        lines.append(
            f"What: {idea.get('what', 'Not available')}"
        )

        if idea.get("why"):
            lines.append(f"Why: {idea['why']}")

        fields = [
            ("period_return_pct", "Historical return", "%"),
            ("annualized_volatility_pct", "Annualised volatility", "%"),
            ("maximum_drawdown_pct", "Maximum drawdown", "%"),
            ("sharpe_ratio", "Sharpe ratio", ""),
            ("observations", "Return observations", ""),
        ]

        for key, label, suffix in fields:
            value = evidence.get(key)

            if value is not None:
                lines.append(f"{label}: {value}{suffix}")

        if idea.get("risk"):
            lines.append(f"Risk: {idea['risk']}")

        lines.append("")

    lines.extend([
        "DATA METHODOLOGY",
        f"Index: {metadata.get('index')}",
        f"Period: {metadata.get('period')}",
        f"Data as of: {metadata.get('data_as_of')}",
        f"Snapshot month: {metadata.get('snapshot_month')}",
        f"Price basis: {metadata.get('price_basis')}",
        (
            "Corporate-action coverage: "
            f"{metadata.get('corporate_action_coverage')}"
        ),
        f"Dividend adjusted: {metadata.get('dividend_adjusted')}",
        "",
        "IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES",
        "These are historical observations, not forecasts.",
        "The universe uses the latest monthly NIFTY 50 snapshot.",
        "Historical daily membership is not reconstructed.",
        "Corporate-action coverage is partial.",
        "Dividends are excluded. This is not a total-return series.",
        "This information is educational research, not investment advice.",
    ])

    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_financial_context(question):
    intent = detect_intent(question)

    if intent == "FUNDAMENTAL_RESEARCH":
        return (
            "QUESTION CATEGORY: FUNDAMENTAL RESEARCH\n\n"
            "VERIFIED DATA STATUS:\n"
            "Company fundamentals and valuation data are not yet "
            "integrated into GREEDY STOCKS.\n"
            "Historical share-price performance cannot establish "
            "whether a company is undervalued or overvalued.\n"
            "Do not invent financial statements, revenue, profit, "
            "debt, cash flow or valuation ratios.\n"
            "You may explain what data would be needed for "
            "a proper fundamental analysis."
        )

    if intent == "EDUCATION":
        return (
            "QUESTION CATEGORY: FINANCIAL EDUCATION\n"
            "Explain NIFTY 50 and basic stock market concepts "
            "at a beginner-friendly level.\n"
            "Do not invent current market figures."
        )

    if intent == "GENERAL":
        return (
            "QUESTION CATEGORY: GENERAL GREEDY STOCKS HELP\n"
            "GREEDY STOCKS currently supports:\n"
            "- Historical NIFTY 50 stock performance.\n"
            "- Historical volatility and drawdown.\n"
            "- NIFTY 50 sector performance.\n"
            "- Historical Greedy Algorithm experiments.\n"
            "- Financial education and beginner explanations.\n"
            "Fundamental valuation data is not yet integrated."
        )

    period = detect_period(question)

    try:
        report = generate_market_ideas(
            period=period,
            top_n=5,
        )

        metadata = report["metadata"]
        ideas = report["ideas"]

        verified_context = format_insights(
            ideas=ideas,
            metadata=metadata,
            category=intent,
        )

        return (
            f"QUESTION CATEGORY: {intent}\n"
            f"REQUESTED PERIOD: {period}\n\n"
            "THE FOLLOWING IS VERIFIED APPLICATION DATA. "
            "Do not modify or invent its figures.\n\n"
            f"{verified_context}"
        )

    except Exception:
        logger.exception(
            "Financial intelligence generation failed."
        )

        return (
            "VERIFIED FINANCIAL DATA STATUS: UNAVAILABLE.\n"
            "Do not invent or estimate financial figures.\n"
            "Explain that the financial analysis could not "
            "be retrieved at this time."
        )


# --------------------------------------------------
# GEMINI AI ENGINE
# --------------------------------------------------

def generate_gemini_answer(question, financial_context, history):
    api_key = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY")

    if not api_key:
        logger.warning("GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.")
        return None

    try:
        from google import genai

        client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)

        calculation_context = build_calculation_context(
            client=client,
            model=GEMINI_MODEL,
            question=question,
        )

        greedy_knowledge_context = build_greedy_knowledge_context(
            question=question,
        )

        historical_company_context = (
            build_historical_intelligence_context(
                client=client,
                model=GEMINI_MODEL,
                question=question,
            )
            if re.search(
                r"\b(analy[sz]e|analysis of|historical performance of|historical returns of|returns? of|sharpe(?: ratio)? of|volatility of|drawdown of)\b",
                question or "",
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )
            else "No company-specific historical analysis requested."
        )

        greedy_v2_evidence_context = build_greedy_v2_evidence_context(question)



        conversation_text = ""

        for item in history:
            role = item["role"].upper()
            content = item["content"]

            conversation_text += (
                f"\n{role}: {content}\n"
            )

        prompt = f"""
VERIFIED APPLICATION CONTEXT:

{financial_context}

COMPANY-SPECIFIC HISTORICAL INTELLIGENCE:
{historical_company_context}

GREEDY V2 EXPERIMENT AND WALK-FORWARD EVIDENCE:
{greedy_v2_evidence_context}

GREEDY SOURCE-CODE KNOWLEDGE:

{greedy_knowledge_context}

SOURCE KNOWLEDGE RULES:
- Use source excerpts to explain actual Greedy implementation.
- Distinguish Greedy V1, V2 and V3 only when the source supports it.
- Explain selection logic, objective functions, constraints and limitations
  only when visible in the supplied code.
- If a requested version or implementation is not found, say so.
- Never claim to have run an algorithm merely because its source was read.
- Never change algorithm behaviour or portfolio-generation decisions.
- Never invent source files, functions, metrics or algorithm features.


DETERMINISTIC CALCULATION ENGINE OUTPUT:

{calculation_context}

CALCULATION RULES:
- If status is CALCULATED, use the exact result and supplied inputs.
- Explain the formula, units and assumptions.
- Do not alter or invent calculated values.
- If no calculation was executed, do not claim one was verified.
- User-provided mathematical inputs do not require external market data.
- Distinguish mathematical examples from actual market observations.


RECENT CONVERSATION HISTORY:
{conversation_text if conversation_text else "No previous messages."}

CURRENT USER QUESTION:
{question}

INSTRUCTIONS:
Answer the current question directly.

Use the verified application context for all financial figures.
If the context says data is unavailable, do not invent it.
Use conversation history to understand follow-up questions.
Explain concepts in beginner-friendly language.
Keep the answer clear, useful and conversational.
"""

        interaction = client.interactions.create(
            model=GEMINI_MODEL,
            input=prompt,
            system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION,
        )

        answer = interaction.output_text

        if not answer or not answer.strip():
            logger.warning("Gemini returned an empty response.")
            return None

        return answer.strip()

    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Gemini API request failed.")
        return None


# --------------------------------------------------
# MAIN RESPONSE ENGINE
# --------------------------------------------------

def generate_greedy_answer(question, history):
    financial_context = build_financial_context(question)

    # Deterministic fallback is always available.
    fallback_answer = financial_context

    ai_answer = generate_gemini_answer(
        question=question,
        financial_context=financial_context,
        history=history,
    )

    if ai_answer:
        return ai_answer

    logger.warning(
        "Using deterministic fallback response."
    )

    return (
        "GREEDY AI is temporarily unavailable, so I'm "
        "showing the verified application information instead.\n\n"
        f"{fallback_answer}"
    )


# --------------------------------------------------
# SEND CHAT MESSAGE
# --------------------------------------------------

@router.post("/chat", response_model=ChatResponse)
def send_message(request: ChatRequest):
    question = request.message.strip()

    if not question:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Message cannot be empty.",
        )

    try:
        # Validate existing conversation and load its history.
        history = get_recent_history(request.conversation_id)

        # Generate the answer before opening the write transaction.
        answer = generate_greedy_answer(
            question=question,
            history=history,
        )

        with engine.begin() as connection:
            user_id = get_or_create_dev_user(connection)

            if request.conversation_id is None:
                result = connection.execute(
                    text("""
                        INSERT INTO conversations (
                            user_id,
                            title
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :user_id,
                            :title
                        )
                    """),
                    {
                        "user_id": user_id,
                        "title": question[:255],
                    },
                )

                conversation_id = result.lastrowid

            else:
                conversation_id = request.conversation_id

            connection.execute(
                text("""
                    INSERT INTO messages (
                        conversation_id,
                        role,
                        content
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :conversation_id,
                        'user',
                        :content
                    )
                """),
                {
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "content": question,
                },
            )

            connection.execute(
                text("""
                    INSERT INTO messages (
                        conversation_id,
                        role,
                        content
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :conversation_id,
                        'assistant',
                        :content
                    )
                """),
                {
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "content": answer,
                },
            )

            connection.execute(
                text("""
                    UPDATE conversations
                    SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = :conversation_id
                """),
                {"conversation_id": conversation_id},
            )

        return ChatResponse(
            conversation_id=conversation_id,
            user_message=question,
            assistant_message=answer,
            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    except HTTPException:
        raise

    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Chat message processing failed.")

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Chat service failed. Check backend logs.",
        )




# --------------------------------------------------
# LIST CONVERSATIONS
# --------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/chat/conversations")
def list_conversations(limit: int = 100):
    """
    Return the development user's recent conversations,
    newest activity first, with a short latest-message preview.
    """
    if limit < 1 or limit > 200:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Limit must be between 1 and 200.",
        )

    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            user_id = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM app_users
                    WHERE email = :email
                """),
                {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
            ).scalar_one_or_none()

            if user_id is None:
                return {"conversations": []}

            rows = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        c.id,
                        c.title,
                        c.created_at,
                        c.updated_at,
                        (
                            SELECT m.content
                            FROM messages AS m
                            WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
                            ORDER BY m.id DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) AS last_message,
                        (
                            SELECT COUNT(*)
                            FROM messages AS mc
                            WHERE mc.conversation_id = c.id
                        ) AS message_count
                    FROM conversations AS c
                    WHERE c.user_id = :user_id
                    ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC
                    LIMIT :limit
                """),
                {
                    "user_id": user_id,
                    "limit": limit,
                },
            ).mappings().all()

            return {
                "conversations": [
                    dict(row) for row in rows
                ]
            }

    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Conversation list retrieval failed.")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Could not retrieve conversation history.",
        )

# RETRIEVE CONVERSATION
# --------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/chat/conversations/{conversation_id}")
def get_conversation(conversation_id: int):
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            user_id = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM app_users
                    WHERE email = :email
                """),
                {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
            ).scalar_one_or_none()

            if user_id is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail="User not found.",
                )

            conversation = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id, title, created_at, updated_at
                    FROM conversations
                    WHERE id = :conversation_id
                      AND user_id = :user_id
                """),
                {
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "user_id": user_id,
                },
            ).mappings().first()

            if conversation is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail="Conversation not found.",
                )

            messages = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id, role, content, created_at
                    FROM messages
                    WHERE conversation_id = :conversation_id
                    ORDER BY id ASC
                """),
                {"conversation_id": conversation_id},
            ).mappings().all()

            return {
                "conversation": dict(conversation),
                "messages": [dict(message) for message in messages],
            }

    except HTTPException:
        raise

    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Conversation retrieval failed.")

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Could not retrieve conversation.",
        )

@router.delete("/chat/conversations/{conversation_id}")
def delete_conversation(conversation_id: int):
    """
    Delete one conversation belonging to the development user
    and all of its messages.
    """
    try:
        with engine.begin() as connection:
            user_id = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM app_users
                    WHERE email = :email
                """),
                {"email": DEV_USER_EMAIL},
            ).scalar_one_or_none()

            if user_id is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail="Conversation not found.",
                )

            exists = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM conversations
                    WHERE id = :conversation_id
                      AND user_id = :user_id
                """),
                {
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "user_id": user_id,
                },
            ).scalar_one_or_none()

            if exists is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail="Conversation not found.",
                )

            connection.execute(
                text("""
                    DELETE FROM messages
                    WHERE conversation_id = :conversation_id
                """),
                {"conversation_id": conversation_id},
            )

            connection.execute(
                text("""
                    DELETE FROM conversations
                    WHERE id = :conversation_id
                      AND user_id = :user_id
                """),
                {
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "user_id": user_id,
                },
            )

        return {
            "success": True,
            "conversation_id": conversation_id,
            "message": "Conversation deleted successfully.",
        }

    except HTTPException:
        raise

    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Conversation deletion failed.")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Could not delete conversation.",
        )

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import text

from database import engine

router = APIRouter(tags=["Companies"])


def serialize_value(value):
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()

    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return float(value)

    return value


@router.get("/companies/{symbol}")
def get_company_profile(symbol: str):
    symbol = symbol.strip().upper()

    if not symbol or len(symbol) > 30:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Invalid company symbol.",
        )

    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            company = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        c.id,
                        c.symbol,
                        c.company_name,
                        c.isin,
                        c.exchange,
                        c.is_active,
                        s.name AS sector,
                        s.description AS sector_description
                    FROM companies c
                    LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = c.sector_id
                    WHERE c.symbol = :symbol
                    LIMIT 1
                """),
                {"symbol": symbol},
            ).mappings().first()

            if not company:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail=f"Company {symbol} was not found.",
                )

            company_id = company["id"]

            coverage = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        MIN(trade_date) AS first_trade_date,
                        MAX(trade_date) AS latest_trade_date,
                        COUNT(*) AS observations
                    FROM stock_prices
                    WHERE company_id = :company_id
                """),
                {"company_id": company_id},
            ).mappings().first()

            latest_price = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        trade_date,
                        open_price,
                        high_price,
                        low_price,
                        close_price,
                        previous_close,
                        total_traded_volume,
                        total_traded_value,
                        total_trades,
                        price_source
                    FROM stock_prices
                    WHERE company_id = :company_id
                    ORDER BY trade_date DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                """),
                {"company_id": company_id},
            ).mappings().first()

            actions = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        action_type,
                        announcement_date,
                        ex_date,
                        record_date,
                        effective_date,
                        description,
                        ratio,
                        dividend_amount,
                        source_name,
                        source_reference
                    FROM corporate_actions
                    WHERE company_id = :company_id
                    ORDER BY COALESCE(
                        ex_date,
                        effective_date,
                        announcement_date
                    ) DESC
                    LIMIT 50
                """),
                {"company_id": company_id},
            ).mappings().all()

            identifiers = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        identifier_type,
                        identifier_value,
                        valid_from,
                        valid_to,
                        source_name,
                        source_reference
                    FROM company_identifiers
                    WHERE company_id = :company_id
                    ORDER BY valid_from
                """),
                {"company_id": company_id},
            ).mappings().all()

        return {
            "company": {
                "symbol": company["symbol"],
                "company_name": company["company_name"],
                "isin": company["isin"],
                "exchange": company["exchange"],
                "is_active": bool(company["is_active"]),
                "sector": company["sector"],
                "sector_description": company["sector_description"],
            },
            "price_coverage": {
                "first_price_date": serialize_value(
                    coverage["first_trade_date"]
                ),
                "last_price_date": serialize_value(
                    coverage["latest_trade_date"]
                ),
                "observations": int(coverage["observations"] or 0),
                "price_basis": "RAW_CLOSE_UNADJUSTED",
            },
            "latest_price": (
                {
                    key: serialize_value(value)
                    for key, value in latest_price.items()
                }
                if latest_price else None
            ),
            "corporate_actions": [
                {
                    key: serialize_value(value)
                    for key, value in action.items()
                }
                for action in actions
            ],
            "identifiers": [
                {
                    key: serialize_value(value)
                    for key, value in identifier.items()
                }
                for identifier in identifiers
            ],
            "data_limitations": [
                "Latest price is an unadjusted raw closing price.",
                "Corporate action coverage is limited to imported records.",
                "Dividend-adjusted total-return history is not provided.",
                "Company fundamentals and valuation data are not integrated.",
                "Historical price coverage does not establish historical NIFTY 50 membership.",
            ],
        }

    except HTTPException:
        raise

    except Exception as error:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Unable to retrieve the company profile.",
        ) from error

"""GREEDY STOCKS ? configurable Greedy V2 portfolio API."""

import logging
import math
import sys
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, FiniteFloat

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from analytics.greedy_v2_data import prepare_greedy_v2_dataset
from analytics.greedy_v2_splits import chronological_split
from analytics.greedy_v2_engine import greedy_select_stocks
from analytics.portfolio_analytics import (
    calculate_portfolio,
    compare_with_benchmark,
)
from analytics.portfolio_allocation import allocate_capital

router = APIRouter(tags=["Portfolio"])
logger = logging.getLogger("greedy_stocks_portfolio")


class PortfolioRequest(BaseModel):
    capital: FiniteFloat = Field(gt=0, le=100_000_000_000)
    stock_count: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10)
    training_years: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=10)
    max_per_sector: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    selected_symbols: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    risk_free_rate: FiniteFloat = Field(default=0.0, ge=0, le=1)


def _clean(value):
    if hasattr(value, "item"):
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, (date,)):
        return value.isoformat()
    if hasattr(value, "isoformat") and not isinstance(value, str):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None
    return value


def _metrics(result):
    return {
        str(key): _clean(value)
        for key, value in result["metrics"].items()
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool))
        or value is None
    }


@router.post("/portfolio/generate")
def generate_portfolio(request: PortfolioRequest):
    """Generate a capital-constrained portfolio using original Greedy V2."""
    try:
        today = date.today()
        end_date = today.isoformat()
        start_date = (today - timedelta(days=365 * request.training_years)).isoformat()

        dataset = prepare_greedy_v2_dataset(
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
        )

        split = chronological_split(
            dataset.adjusted_prices,
            allow_sparse_evaluation=True,
        )

        # Greedy selection sees training data only.
        selection = greedy_select_stocks(
            train_prices=split.train,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            target_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            fixed_symbols=request.selected_symbols,
        )

        symbols = selection["selected_symbols"]

        # Latest raw close is used for executable share quantities.
        latest_prices = {}

        for symbol in symbols:
            raw_column = (
                symbol if symbol in dataset.raw_prices.columns
                else f"{symbol}_RAW"
            )

            if raw_column not in dataset.raw_prices.columns:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Raw price history unavailable for {symbol} "
                    f"(expected column: {raw_column})."
                )

            available = dataset.raw_prices[raw_column].dropna()

            if available.empty:
                raise ValueError(f"No usable raw price is available for {symbol}.")

            latest_prices[symbol] = float(available.iloc[-1])

        allocation = allocate_capital(
            symbols=symbols,
            prices=latest_prices,
            capital=float(request.capital),
        )

        # Validation-period metrics are kept separate from training selection.
        validation_prices = split.validation
        validation_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(split.validation.index)

        validation_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=validation_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_prices = split.test
        test_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(test_prices.index)

        test_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=test_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            test_result["daily_returns"],
            test_benchmark,
        )

        comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            validation_result["daily_returns"],
            validation_benchmark,
        )

        holdings = allocation["holdings"]
        for holding in holdings:
            holding["sector"] = dataset.sectors[holding["symbol"]]

        return {
            "status": "success",
            "selection_method": "SEQUENTIAL_GREEDY_SHARPE",
            "portfolio": allocation,
            "holdings": holdings,
            "selection_log": selection["selection_log"].to_dict(
                orient="records"
            ),
            "training": {
                "start": str(split.train.index.min().date()),
                "end": str(split.train.index.max().date()),
                "observations": len(split.train),
                "selection_sharpe": _clean(
                    selection["portfolio_result"]["metrics"].get("sharpe_ratio")
                ),
            },
            "validation": {
                "start": str(validation_prices.index.min().date()),
                "end": str(validation_prices.index.max().date()),
                "observations": len(validation_prices),
                "metrics": _metrics(validation_result),
                "benchmark": {
                    key: _clean(value)
                    for key, value in comparison.items()
                    if key != "comparison_returns"
                },
            },
            "test": {
                "start": str(test_prices.index[1].date()),
                "end": str(test_prices.index[-1].date()),
                "observations": len(test_prices) - 1,
                "metrics": _metrics(test_result),
                "benchmark": {
                    key: _clean(value)
                    for key, value in test_comparison.items()
                    if key != "comparison_returns"
                },
            },
            "data_limitations": {
                "membership_basis": dataset.metadata["membership_basis"],
                "corporate_action_coverage": dataset.metadata[
                    "corporate_action_coverage"
                ],
                "dividend_adjusted": dataset.metadata["dividend_adjusted"],
                "price_basis": dataset.metadata["price_basis"],
                "benchmark_basis": "NIFTY_50_PRICE_RETURN",
                "historical_membership_survivorship_bias": True,
                "historical_metrics_are_daily_rebalanced": True,
                "live_holdings_use_latest_raw_close": True,
            },
            "assumptions": selection["assumptions"],
        }

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Portfolio generation failed.")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Portfolio generation failed. Check backend logs.",
        ) from exc
"""GREEDY STOCKS - Configurable Greedy V2 portfolio API."""

import logging
import math
import sys
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, FiniteFloat

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from analytics.greedy_v2_data import prepare_greedy_v2_dataset
from analytics.greedy_v2_splits import chronological_split
from analytics.greedy_v2_engine import greedy_select_stocks
from analytics.portfolio_analytics import (
    calculate_portfolio,
    compare_with_benchmark,
)
from analytics.portfolio_allocation import allocate_capital

router = APIRouter(tags=["Portfolio"])
logger = logging.getLogger("greedy_stocks_portfolio")


class PortfolioRequest(BaseModel):
    capital: FiniteFloat = Field(gt=0, le=100_000_000_000)
    stock_count: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10)
    training_years: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=10)
    max_per_sector: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    selected_symbols: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    risk_free_rate: FiniteFloat = Field(default=0.0, ge=0, le=1)


def _clean(value):
    """Convert NumPy/Pandas values into JSON-safe Python values."""
    if value is None:
        return None

    if value is pd.NaT or value is pd.NA:
        return None

    if isinstance(value, (pd.Timestamp, date)):
        return value.isoformat()

    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        value = value.item()

    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _clean(v) for k, v in value.items()}

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_clean(v) for v in value]

    return value


def _metrics(result):
    return _clean(result.get("metrics", {}))


def _period_summary(prices, include_baseline=True):
    if prices is None or prices.empty:
        raise ValueError("Insufficient historical observations for this period.")

    start_index = 0 if include_baseline else 1

    if len(prices) <= start_index:
        raise ValueError("Insufficient historical observations for this period.")

    measured = prices.iloc[start_index:]

    return {
        "start": str(measured.index.min().date()),
        "end": str(measured.index.max().date()),
        "observations": len(measured),
    }


def _benchmark_summary(comparison):
    return {
        str(key): _clean(value)
        for key, value in comparison.items()
        if key != "comparison_returns"
    }


@router.post("/portfolio/generate")
def generate_portfolio(request: PortfolioRequest):
    """Generate a capital-constrained portfolio using original Greedy V2."""

    try:
        today = date.today()
        end_date = today.isoformat()
        start_date = (
            today - timedelta(days=365 * request.training_years)
        ).isoformat()

        dataset = prepare_greedy_v2_dataset(
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
        )

        if dataset.adjusted_prices is None or dataset.adjusted_prices.empty:
            raise ValueError("No adjusted historical stock prices are available.")

        if dataset.benchmark_prices is None or dataset.benchmark_prices.empty:
            raise ValueError("Historical NIFTY 50 benchmark prices are unavailable.")

        # Chronological split: selection uses training data only.
        split = chronological_split(dataset.adjusted_prices, allow_sparse_evaluation=True)

        if split.train.empty or split.validation.empty or split.test.empty:
            raise ValueError(
                "Insufficient historical data to create train, validation and test periods."
            )

        # Preserve the original sequential Greedy V2 selection algorithm.
        selection = greedy_select_stocks(
            train_prices=split.train,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            target_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            fixed_symbols=request.selected_symbols,
        )

        symbols = selection["selected_symbols"]

        if not symbols:
            raise ValueError("Greedy V2 did not select any stocks.")

        # Latest available raw close is used for executable share quantities.
        latest_prices = {}

        for symbol in symbols:
            raw_column = (
                symbol if symbol in dataset.raw_prices.columns
                else f"{symbol}_RAW"
            )
            if raw_column not in dataset.raw_prices.columns:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Raw price history is unavailable for {symbol}."
                )

            available = dataset.raw_prices[raw_column].dropna()

            if available.empty:
                raise ValueError(f"No usable raw price is available for {symbol}.")

            latest_prices[symbol] = float(available.iloc[-1])

        allocation = allocate_capital(
            symbols=symbols,
            prices=latest_prices,
            capital=float(request.capital),
        )

        holdings = allocation["holdings"]

        for holding in holdings:
            symbol = holding["symbol"]
            holding["sector"] = dataset.sectors.get(symbol, "Unknown")

        # Validation period: evaluate selected symbols without re-selection.
        validation_prices = split.validation
        validation_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(
            validation_prices.index
        )

        validation_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=validation_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        validation_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            validation_result["daily_returns"],
            validation_benchmark,
        )

        # Final test period remains separate from training and validation.
        test_prices = split.test
        test_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(test_prices.index)

        test_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=test_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            test_result["daily_returns"],
            test_benchmark,
        )

        training_period = _period_summary(split.train)
        validation_period = _period_summary(validation_prices, include_baseline=False)
        test_period = _period_summary(test_prices, include_baseline=False)

        return _clean({
            "status": "success",
            "selection_method": "SEQUENTIAL_GREEDY_SHARPE",
            "portfolio": allocation,
            "holdings": holdings,
            "selection_log": selection["selection_log"].to_dict(
                orient="records"
            ),
            "training": {
                **training_period,
                "selection_sharpe": selection["portfolio_result"][
                    "metrics"
                ].get("sharpe_ratio"),
            },
            "validation": {
                **validation_period,
                "metrics": _metrics(validation_result),
                "benchmark": _benchmark_summary(validation_comparison),
            },
            "test": {
                **test_period,
                "metrics": _metrics(test_result),
                "benchmark": _benchmark_summary(test_comparison),
            },
            "data_limitations": {
                "membership_basis": dataset.metadata["membership_basis"],
                "corporate_action_coverage": dataset.metadata[
                    "corporate_action_coverage"
                ],
                "dividend_adjusted": dataset.metadata["dividend_adjusted"],
                "price_basis": dataset.metadata["price_basis"],
                "benchmark_basis": "NIFTY_50_PRICE_RETURN",
                "historical_membership_survivorship_bias": True,
                "historical_metrics_are_daily_rebalanced": True,
                "live_holdings_use_latest_raw_close": True,
                "actual_holdings_buy_and_hold_metrics_calculated": False,
                "training_candidate_count": len(split.metadata["eligible_training_symbols"]),
                "excluded_incomplete_training_symbols": split.metadata[
                    "excluded_incomplete_training_symbols"
                ],
                "validation_test_missing_prices_filled": False,
            },
            "assumptions": selection["assumptions"],
        })

    except ValueError as exc:
        logger.warning("Portfolio request rejected: %s", exc)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Portfolio generation failed.")
        # Diagnostic detail is temporary. Replace with a generic message
        # before deploying this endpoint publicly.
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
        ) from exc


================================================================================
FILE: backend\sector_routes.py

from datetime import date, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy import text

from database import engine


router = APIRouter(tags=["NIFTY 50 Sectors"])

PERIOD_DAYS = {
    "1M": 30,
    "3M": 90,
    "6M": 180,
    "1Y": 365,
}


def serialize(value):
    if isinstance(value, (date,)):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return float(value)
    return value


def get_sector_data(period: str):
    if period not in PERIOD_DAYS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Period must be 1M, 3M, 6M, or 1Y.",
        )

    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            snapshot_month = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT MAX(report_month)
                    FROM index_constituent_snapshots
                    WHERE index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
                """)
            ).scalar()

            if snapshot_month is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=503,
                    detail="NIFTY 50 constituent snapshot is unavailable.",
                )

            companies = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        c.id AS company_id,
                        c.symbol,
                        c.company_name,
                        s.id AS sector_id,
                        s.name AS sector_name,
                        s.description AS sector_description,
                        snap.weightage
                    FROM index_constituent_snapshots snap
                    INNER JOIN companies c
                        ON c.symbol = snap.symbol
                    LEFT JOIN sectors s
                        ON s.id = c.sector_id
                    WHERE snap.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
                      AND snap.report_month = :snapshot_month
                    ORDER BY s.name, c.company_name
                """),
                {"snapshot_month": snapshot_month},
            ).mappings().all()

            latest_date = connection.execute(
                text("SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_prices")
            ).scalar()

            if latest_date is None:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=503,
                    detail="Historical stock price data is unavailable.",
                )

            target_date = latest_date - timedelta(
                days=PERIOD_DAYS[period]
            )

            price_rows = connection.execute(
                text("""
                    SELECT
                        c.id AS company_id,

                        (
                            SELECT p.close_price
                            FROM stock_prices p
                            WHERE p.company_id = c.id
                              AND p.trade_date <= :target_date
                              AND p.close_price > 0
                            ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) AS start_price,

                        (
                            SELECT p.trade_date
                            FROM stock_prices p
                            WHERE p.company_id = c.id
                              AND p.trade_date <= :target_date
                              AND p.close_price > 0
                            ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) AS start_date,

                        (
                            SELECT p.close_price
                            FROM stock_prices p
                            WHERE p.company_id = c.id
                              AND p.trade_date <= :latest_date
                              AND p.close_price > 0
                            ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) AS end_price,

                        (
                            SELECT p.trade_date
                            FROM stock_prices p
                            WHERE p.company_id = c.id
                              AND p.trade_date <= :latest_date
                              AND p.close_price > 0
                            ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) AS end_date

                    FROM companies c
                    WHERE c.id IN :company_ids
                """).bindparams(),
                {
                    "target_date": target_date,
                    "latest_date": latest_date,
                    "company_ids": tuple(
                        row["company_id"] for row in companies
                    ) or (-1,),
                },
            ).mappings().all()

        prices_by_company = {
            row["company_id"]: row
            for row in price_rows
        }

        sector_groups = {}

        for company in companies:
            sector_id = company["sector_id"]
            sector_name = company["sector_name"] or "Unclassified"

            if sector_id not in sector_groups:
                sector_groups[sector_id] = {
                    "sector_id": sector_id,
                    "sector_name": sector_name,
                    "sector_description": company["sector_description"],
                    "companies": [],
                    "returns": [],
                }

            price = prices_by_company.get(company["company_id"])

            company_return = None

            if (
                price
                and price["start_price"]
                and price["end_price"]
                and float(price["start_price"]) > 0
            ):
                company_return = (
                    float(price["end_price"])
                    / float(price["start_price"])
                    - 1
                ) * 100

                sector_groups[sector_id]["returns"].append(
                    company_return
                )

            sector_groups[sector_id]["companies"].append({
                "symbol": company["symbol"],
                "company_name": company["company_name"],
                "weightage": serialize(company["weightage"]),
                "start_date": serialize(
                    price["start_date"] if price else None
                ),
                "end_date": serialize(
                    price["end_date"] if price else None
                ),
                "period_return_pct": (
                    round(company_return, 4)
                    if company_return is not None
                    else None
                ),
            })

        sectors = []

        for group in sector_groups.values():
            returns = group.pop("returns")
            sector_companies = group["companies"]

            available = len(returns)
            total = len(sector_companies)

            average_return = (
                sum(returns) / available
                if available
                else None
            )

            sector_companies.sort(
                key=lambda item: (
                    item["period_return_pct"] is None,
                    -(item["period_return_pct"] or 0),
                )
            )

            sectors.append({
                **group,
                "company_count": total,
                "companies_with_price_data": available,
                "average_constituent_return_pct": (
                    round(average_return, 4)
                    if average_return is not None
                    else None
                ),
                "data_coverage_pct": round(
                    available / total * 100, 2
                ) if total else 0,
            })

        sectors.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                item["average_constituent_return_pct"] is None,
                -(item["average_constituent_return_pct"] or 0),
            )
        )

        return {
            "index": "NIFTY 50",
            "period": period,
            "snapshot_month": serialize(snapshot_month),
            "data_as_of": serialize(latest_date),
            "comparison_target_date": serialize(target_date),
            "sector_count": len(sectors),
            "company_count": len(companies),
            "sectors": sectors,
            "methodology": {
                "membership_basis": "LATEST_MONTHLY_NIFTY_50_SNAPSHOT",
                "return_method": "EQUAL_WEIGHT_AVERAGE_OF_CONSTITUENT_PRICE_RETURNS",
                "price_basis": "RAW_CLOSE_UNADJUSTED",
                "return_type": "PRICE_RETURN",
                "dividend_adjusted": False,
                "official_sector_index": False,
                "database_writes": False,
            },
            "limitations": [
                "Membership reflects the latest monthly NIFTY 50 snapshot, not historical membership for each date.",
                "Sector performance is the equal-weight average of available constituent price returns, not an official sector index.",
                "Raw unadjusted closing prices are used; corporate actions are not adjusted in this endpoint.",
                "Dividend-adjusted total returns are not available.",
                "Companies without valid prices on both comparison dates are excluded from the sector average.",
                "The comparison start uses each company's latest available close on or before the target date.",
            ],
        }

    except HTTPException:
        raise

    except Exception as error:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Unable to generate NIFTY 50 sector data.",
        ) from error


@router.get("/sectors")
def list_sectors(
    period: str = Query(
        default="3M",
        pattern="^(1M|3M|6M|1Y)$",
    ),
):
    """Return sector summaries and their NIFTY 50 constituents."""
    return get_sector_data(period)


@router.get("/sectors/{sector_id}")
def get_sector(
    sector_id: int,
    period: str = Query(
        default="3M",
        pattern="^(1M|3M|6M|1Y)$",
    ),
):
    """Return one sector and its NIFTY 50 constituent details."""
    report = get_sector_data(period)

    for sector in report["sectors"]:
        if sector["sector_id"] == sector_id:
            return {
                **report,
                "sectors": [sector],
            }

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=404,
        detail="Sector not found in the latest NIFTY 50 snapshot.",
    )

type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (

          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">

            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">

          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">

            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
