// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="greedy-welcome flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">

              

              
<p className="greedy-welcome-tagline">
  Understand the market. <span>Question the numbers.</span> Build your conviction.
</p>

              

              <div className="greedy-welcome-suggestions hidden">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="greedy-chat-scroll flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
  <div className="flex justify-start" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div className="greedy-analysing py-4 text-[14px] font-medium tracking-[-0.02em]">
      Analysing...
    </div>
  </div>
)}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
{/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="greedy-composer greedy-welcome-composer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-[#353535] bg-[#1c1c1c] px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_5px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] transition-all duration-200 focus-within:border-[#555555]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={1}
                placeholder="Ask GREEDY"
                
                className="greedy-composer-input max-h-40 min-h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent px-1 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                aria-label={loading ? "GREEDY is analysing" : "Send message"}
                className="greedy-send-button flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
              >
                {loading ? <Square size={13} fill="currentColor" strokeWidth={0} /> : <ArrowUp size={19} /> }
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS &middot; Educational research only &middot; Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden
            border-r border-[#262626] bg-[#000000]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {

                  key={item.name}

                      active

                    }

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

          <div className={`mt-7 flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777]">
                Your chats
              </p>

            <button

                <button className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#2a2a2a] px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] sm:flex">

// --------------------------------------------------
// REUSABLE MARKET CARD
// --------------------------------------------------

function MarketCard({
  label,
  value,
  change,
  positive,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  positive: boolean;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 transition hover:border-[#555555]">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-[#999999]">
          {label}
        </p>

        <span className="text-[#aaaaaa]">{icon}</span>
      </div>

      <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
        {value}
      </p>

      <p
        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
          positive ? "text-[#75b798]" : "text-[#d5b477]"
        }`}
      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {

} from "lucide-react";

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

type Holding = {
  symbol: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  invested: number;
  weight: number;
  sector?: string;
};

type PeriodResult = {
  start?: string;
  end?: string;
  observations?: number;
  metrics?: {
    period_return_pct?: number;
    cagr_pct?: number;
    annualized_volatility_pct?: number;
    maximum_drawdown_pct?: number;
    sharpe_ratio?: number;
  };
  benchmark?: {
    portfolio_return_pct?: number;
    benchmark_return_pct?: number;
    excess_return_pct?: number;
  };
};

type PortfolioResult = {
  status: string;
  selection_method: string;
  portfolio: {
    capital: number;
    invested: number;
    cash_remaining: number;
    stock_count: number;
    holdings: Holding[];
  };
  selection_log: {
    step: number;
    symbol: string;
    portfolio_sharpe: number;
    marginal_sharpe_change: number | null;
  }[];
  training: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    observations: number;
    selection_sharpe: number;
  };
  validation: PeriodResult;
  test: PeriodResult;
  data_limitations: {
    historical_membership_survivorship_bias?: boolean;
    dividend_adjusted?: boolean;
    corporate_action_coverage?: string;
    validation_test_missing_prices_filled?: boolean;
  };
  assumptions: {
    selection_method: string;
    daily_rebalancing: boolean;
    selection_uses_training_data_only: boolean;
    globally_optimal: boolean;
    user_selected_symbols?: string[];
    greedy_selected_symbols?: string[];
  };
};

const money = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number"
    ? value.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
      })
    : "?";

const pct = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number" ? `${value.toFixed(2)}%` : "?";

function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#000000] p-4">
      <p className="text-xs text-[#a3a3a3]">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-white">{value}</p>
      {detail && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#888]">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Performance({
  title,
  period,
}: {
  title: string;
  period: PeriodResult;
}) {
  const m = period.metrics;
  const b = period.benchmark;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#171717] p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-[#999]">
          {period.start ?? "?"} to {period.end ?? "?"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Metric label="Period return" value={pct(m?.period_return_pct)} />
        <Metric label="CAGR" value={pct(m?.cagr_pct)} />
        <Metric label="Sharpe ratio" value={m?.sharpe_ratio?.toFixed(3) ?? "?"} />
        <Metric
          label="Annualized volatility"
          value={pct(m?.annualized_volatility_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Maximum drawdown"
          value={pct(m?.maximum_drawdown_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="NIFTY 50 return"
          value={pct(b?.benchmark_return_pct)}
          detail={`Excess return: ${pct(b?.excess_return_pct)}`}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function PortfolioBuilder({ initialSelectedStock = "" }: { initialSelectedStock?: string }) {
  const [capital, setCapital] = useState("100000");
  const [stockCount, setStockCount] = useState("5");
  const [maxPerSector, setMaxPerSector] = useState("3");
  const [trainingYears, setTrainingYears] = useState("10");
  const [riskFreeRate, setRiskFreeRate] = useState("0");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PortfolioResult | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [addedStocks, setAddedStocks] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = "greedy-stocks-selected";
    let saved: string[] = [];

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        saved = parsed.filter(
          (item): item is string => typeof item === "string"
        ).map((item) => item.toUpperCase());
      }
    } catch {
      saved = [];
    }

    const merged = Array.from(new Set([
      ...saved,
      ...(initialSelectedStock ? [initialSelectedStock.toUpperCase()] : []),
    ]));

    setAddedStocks(merged);
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(merged));
  }, [initialSelectedStock]);

  function removeAddedStock(symbol: string) {
    const updated = addedStocks.filter((item) => item !== symbol);
    setAddedStocks(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("greedy-stocks-selected", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  async function generatePortfolio(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/portfolio/generate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          capital: Number(capital),
          stock_count: Number(stockCount),
          training_years: Number(trainingYears),
          max_per_sector: Number(maxPerSector),
          risk_free_rate: Number(riskFreeRate) / 100,
          selected_symbols: addedStocks,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          typeof data.detail === "string"
            ? data.detail
            : JSON.stringify(data.detail ?? "Portfolio generation failed.")
        );
      }

      setResult(data as PortfolioResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Could not connect to GREEDY STOCKS API."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6 p-5 md:p-8">
      <header>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#aaa]">
          <BriefcaseBusiness size={15} />
          GREEDY V2 PORTFOLIO ENGINE
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
          Portfolio Builder
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-[#aaa]">
          Generate a whole-share portfolio using sequential greedy Sharpe
          selection and evaluate it against NIFTY 50.
        </p>
      </header>

      {addedStocks.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
              Your selected stocks
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-cyan-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200">
              {addedStocks.length} {addedStocks.length === 1 ? "stock" : "stocks"} saved
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {addedStocks.map((symbol) => (
              <span key={symbol} className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-cyan-200">
                {symbol}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => removeAddedStock(symbol)}
                  aria-label={`Remove ${symbol}`}
                  className="text-lg leading-none text-cyan-200/70 transition hover:text-red-300"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[#aaa]">
            Your research list is saved in this browser and survives navigation and refreshes.
            These stocks stay in your portfolio. Greedy V2 selects the remaining slots.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
      <form
        onSubmit={generatePortfolio}
        className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5"
      >
        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Investment capital (INR)
          <input
            required
            type="number"
            min="1"
            max="100000000000"
            step="0.01"
            value={capital}
            onChange={(e) => setCapital(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-[#888]"
          />
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Number of stocks
          <select
            value={stockCount}
            onChange={(e) => setStockCount(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} stocks</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Maximum stocks per sector
          <select
            value={maxPerSector}
            onChange={(e) => setMaxPerSector(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Training history
          <select
            value={trainingYears}
            onChange={(e) => setTrainingYears(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} years</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Annual risk-free rate (%)
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            max="100"
            step="0.1"
            value={riskFreeRate}
            onChange={(e) => setRiskFreeRate(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          />
        </label>

        <div className="flex items-end md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-5">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-black transition hover:bg-[#ddd] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:w-auto"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <RefreshCw size={17} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <TrendingUp size={17} />
            )}
            {loading ? "Generating portfolio..." : "Generate Greedy V2 Portfolio"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-red-950/30 p-4 text-sm text-red-300">
          <AlertTriangle size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!result && !loading && !error && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#444] p-10 text-center">
          <Wallet size={30} className="mx-auto text-[#888]" />
          <h3 className="mt-3 font-semibold text-white">
            Your portfolio will appear here
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999]">
            Choose stocks you want to keep. Greedy V2 fills the remaining slots.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <>
          <section className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <Metric label="Starting capital" value={money(result.portfolio.capital)} />
            <Metric label="Amount invested" value={money(result.portfolio.invested)} />
            <Metric label="Cash remaining" value={money(result.portfolio.cash_remaining)} />
            <Metric
              label="Selected stocks"
              value={String(result.portfolio.stock_count)}
              detail="Whole-share allocation"
            />
          </section>

          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]">
            <div className="border-b border-[#303030] p-5">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Your holdings</h2>

                Latest available raw closing prices; quantities are whole shares.

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="text-[#888]">#{index + 1}</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-white">{symbol}</span>

                      USER-SELECTED
                    </span>

              ))}
              {result.selection_log.map((step) => (

                  <div>
                    <span className="mr-3 text-[#888]">#{step.step}</span>

                    Sharpe {step.portfolio_sharpe.toFixed(3)}
                    {step.marginal_sharpe_change !== null && (

                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change.toFixed(3)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <Performance title="Validation performance" period={result.validation} />

          </div>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Methodology and data limitations</h2>
            <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2 text-sm text-[#bbb] md:grid-cols-2">
              <li>? Selection method: {result.assumptions.selection_method}</li>
              <li>? Daily rebalancing: {result.assumptions.daily_rebalancing ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Selection uses training data only: {result.assumptions.selection_uses_training_data_only ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Globally optimal: {result.assumptions.globally_optimal ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Dividend adjusted: {result.data_limitations.dividend_adjusted ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Corporate-action coverage: {result.data_limitations.corporate_action_coverage ?? "Not specified"}</li>
              <li>? Survivorship bias: {result.data_limitations.historical_membership_survivorship_bias ? "Present" : "Not flagged"}</li>
              <li>? Missing evaluation prices filled: {result.data_limitations.validation_test_missing_prices_filled ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-[#303030] pt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#999]">
              Historical validation and test metrics represent a daily-rebalanced,
              equal-weight research portfolio. They are not the realized buy-and-hold
              performance of the whole-share holdings shown above. Historical results
              do not guarantee future returns. For educational research only, not
              investment advice.
            </p>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

const API_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

type CompanyProfile = {
  company: {
    symbol: string;
    company_name: string;
    isin?: string | null;
    exchange?: string | null;
    sector?: string | null;
  };
  price_coverage?: {
    first_price_date?: string | null;
    last_price_date?: string | null;

    trade_date?: string | null;
    close_price?: number | string | null;

    total_traded_volume?: number | string | null;

function formatDate(value?: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "—";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function formatNumber(value?: number | string | null) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
    return "—";
  }

  const number = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return String(value);

  return number.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

function formatCurrency(value?: number | string | null) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
    return "—";
  }

  const number = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return String(value);

  return `₹${number.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function Section({
  title,
  icon,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (

      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 p-2 text-cyan-400">
          {icon}
        </span>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h2>
      </div>

      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-white">{value}</p>

      {detail && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">{detail}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CompanyProfileContent() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();

  const symbol = String(params.symbol || "").toUpperCase();

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<CompanyProfile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function fetchCompany() {
      setLoading(true);

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_URL}/companies/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`,
          {
            signal: controller.signal,
            cache: "no-store",
          }
        );

        if (response.status === 404) {
          throw new Error(`Company ${symbol} was not found.`);
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            `Unable to load company profile (${response.status}).`
          );
        }

        const result: CompanyProfile = await response.json();

        if (!result.company) {
          throw new Error("Unexpected company profile response.");
        }

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setProfile(result);
          setError("");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") {
          return;
        }

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Something went wrong."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void fetchCompany();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [symbol, retryCount]);

  const company = profile?.company;
  const coverage = profile?.price_coverage;
  const latest = profile?.latest_price;

  const actions = profile?.corporate_actions || [];
  const identifiers = profile?.identifiers || [];

  const limitations = Array.isArray(profile?.data_limitations)
    ? profile.data_limitations.map(String)
    : profile?.data_limitations
      ? Object.entries(profile.data_limitations).map(
          ([key, value]) => `${key}: ${String(value)}`
        )
      : [];

  function handleAskGreedy(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!company) return;

    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const question = String(formData.get("question") || "").trim();

    if (!question) return;

    const contextualQuestion =
      `Regarding ${company.company_name} (${company.symbol}): ${question}`;

    router.push(
      `/?question=${encodeURIComponent(contextualQuestion)}`
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#080d18] p-6 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl animate-pulse">
          <div className="mb-6 h-8 w-48 rounded bg-white/10" />

          <div className="h-40 rounded-2xl bg-white/5" />

          <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            {[1, 2, 3].map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item}
                className="h-28 rounded-xl bg-white/5"
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (error || !profile || !company) {
    return (
      <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#080d18] p-6 text-white">
        <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#111827] p-8 text-center">
          <ShieldAlert
            className="mx-auto mb-4 text-amber-400"
            size={38}
          />

          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">
            Profile unavailable
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-400">
            {error || "We couldn't retrieve this company profile."}
          </p>

          <div className="mt-6 flex justify-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => router.back()}
              className="rounded-xl border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-white/5"
            >
              Go back
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setRetryCount((count) => count + 1)}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-black hover:bg-cyan-400"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={15} />
              Retry
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#080d18] px-4 py-6 text-white md:px-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
        <button
          onClick={() => router.back()}
          className="mb-7 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-400 transition hover:text-white"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={17} />
          Back
        </button>

        {/* COMPANY HEADER */}
        <div className="mb-7 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#14243b] to-[#101827] p-6 md:p-8">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 md:flex-row md:items-center">
            <div>
              <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400">
                <Building2 size={15} />
                NIFTY 50 COMPANY PROFILE
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold md:text-4xl">
                {company.company_name}
              </h1>

              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-300">
                <span className="rounded-lg bg-cyan-400/10 px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-cyan-300">
                  {company.symbol}
                </span>

                  {company.sector || "Sector unavailable"}
                </span>

                <span>{company.exchange || "NSE"}</span>
              </div>

              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                Latest recorded close
              </p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold">
                {formatCurrency(latest?.close_price)}

type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ul>
          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="pl-1 leading-7">
              {children}
            </li>
          ),

          hr: () => (
            <hr className="my-6 border-[#505050]" />
          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">
              {children}
            </blockquote>
          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {
            const isBlock = Boolean(className);

            return isBlock ? (
              <code className="block overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#dddddd]">
                {children}
              </code>
            ) : (
              <code className="rounded bg-[#414141] px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-[#eeeeee]">
                {children}
              </code>
            );
          },

          pre: ({ children }) => (
            <pre className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] p-4">
              {children}
            </pre>
          ),

          a: ({ children, href }) => (
            <a
              href={href}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#b8cfff] underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-white"
            >

          table: ({ children }) => (

          td: ({ children }) => (

          ),
        }}
      >
        {content}

// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="greedy-welcome flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">

              

              
<p className="greedy-welcome-tagline">
  Understand the market. <span>Question the numbers.</span> Build your conviction.
</p>

              

              <div className="greedy-welcome-suggestions hidden">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="greedy-chat-scroll flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
  <div className="flex justify-start" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div className="greedy-analysing py-4 text-[14px] font-medium tracking-[-0.02em]">
      Analysing...
    </div>
  </div>
)}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
{/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="greedy-composer greedy-welcome-composer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-[#353535] bg-[#1c1c1c] px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_5px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] transition-all duration-200 focus-within:border-[#555555]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={1}
                placeholder="Ask GREEDY"
                disabled={loading}
                className="greedy-composer-input max-h-40 min-h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent px-1 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                aria-label="Send message"
                className="greedy-send-button flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
              >
                <ArrowUp size={19} />
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS &middot; Educational research only &middot; Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT
// --------------------------------------------------

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden
            border-r border-[#262626] bg-[#000000]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const active = currentNav === item.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.name}
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation(item.name)}
                  title={sidebarCollapsed ? item.name : undefined}
                  aria-label={item.name}
                  className={`
                    flex items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left
                    text-sm transition
                    ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"}
                    ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-[#222222] font-medium text-[#ffffff]"
                        : "text-[#a0a0a0] hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-[#eeeeee]"
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <Icon size={19} className="shrink-0" />

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

          <div className={`mt-7 flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777]">
                Your chats
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={startNewChat}
                title="Start a new chat"
                aria-label="Start a new chat"
                className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-[#aaaaaa] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
              >
                <MessageSquare size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={startNewChat}
              className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#303030] px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] font-medium text-[#c8c8c8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#454545] hover:bg-[#202020] hover:text-white"
            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none">+</span>
              New Chat
            </button>

            <div className="greedy-sidebar-history min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain pr-1">
              {historyLoading && conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#888888]">Loading chats...</p>
              ) : historyError ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-300">{historyError}</p>
              ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[#777777]">
                  Your saved conversations will appear here.
                </p>
              ) : (
                conversations.map((conversation) => {
                  const selected = parsedConversationId === conversation.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={conversation.id}
                      className={`group flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg transition duration-200 ${
                        selected ? "bg-[#303030]" : "hover:bg-[#2a2a2a]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openConversation(conversation.id)}

                      >
                        <span className="block truncate text-xs text-[#dddddd]">
                          {conversation.title || "New conversation"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-[#777777]">
                          {conversation.message_count} messages
                        </span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => void removeConversation(conversation.id)}
                        title="Delete conversation"
                        aria-label={`Delete ${conversation.title || "conversation"}`}
                        className="mr-1 rounded-lg p-2 text-[#777777] opacity-100 transition hover:bg-[#414141] hover:text-red-300 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100"
                      >
                        <X size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SIDEBAR FOOTER */}

          <div className="mt-auto">
            

            <button
              onClick={() => handleNavigation("Settings")}
              title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Settings" : undefined}
              className={`flex w-full items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-white ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"
              }`}
            >
              <Settings size={18} />

              <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                Settings
              </span>
            </button>

            <div
              className={`mt-3 flex items-center border-t border-[#303030] pt-4 ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#383838] text-sm font-bold text-white">
                GS
              </div>

              <div className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                  Market Explorer
                </p>

                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
                  Beginner level
                </p>
              </div>

              {!sidebarCollapsed && (
                <ChevronDown
                  className="ml-auto text-[#888888]"
                  size={15}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* MAIN CONTENT */}

        <section className="min-w-0 flex-1">

          {/* TOP HEADER: HIDDEN ON ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav !== "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-[76px] items-center justify-between border-b border-[#303030] bg-[#000000]/95 px-4 backdrop-blur-xl md:px-7">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                {/* MOBILE SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

                <button
                  onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
                  className="rounded-lg p-2 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white lg:hidden"
                  aria-label="Open sidebar"
                  title="Open sidebar"
                >
                  <Menu size={20} />
                </button>

                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                    {currentNav}
                  </p>

                  <p className="hidden text-[11px] text-[#888888] sm:block">
                    Your personal Indian stock market learning space
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#2a2a2a] px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] sm:flex">

                  Search stocks

                  aria-label="Notifications"
                  className="rounded-xl border border-[#414141] p-2.5 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <Bell size={17} />

              onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
              aria-label="Open sidebar"
              className="fixed left-3 top-3 z-30 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#303030] text-white shadow-lg lg:hidden"
            >
              {mobileMenu ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
            </button>
          )}

          {/* ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav === "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <AskGreedyChat
              key={`ask-greedy-chat-${parsedConversationId ?? "new"}`}
              initialQuestion={questionFromUrl}
              initialConversationId={parsedConversationId}
              onConversationUpdated={() => void refreshConversations()}
            />
          ) : currentNav === "Explore & Discover" ? (
            <ExploreDiscover />
) : currentNav === "Portfolio Builder" ? (
            <PortfolioBuilder initialSelectedStock={stockFromUrl} />
          ) : currentNav === "Learn" ? (
            <LearnPage />
          ) : (

            /* DASHBOARD */

            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] p-5 md:p-8">

              {/* DASHBOARD HEADING */}

              <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#b0b0b0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    YOUR MARKET LEARNING DASHBOARD
                  </div>

                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee] md:text-3xl">
                    Understand the market.{" "}
                    <span className="text-[#999999]">
                      Think smarter.
                    </span>
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999999]">
                    Explore NIFTY 50, discover opportunities and learn investing.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
                >
                  <MessageSquare size={16} />
                  Ask GREEDY
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* DATA NOTICE */}

              <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#555044] bg-[#302d25] p-3.5">
                <Activity
                  className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#e2c98a]"

                />

                <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-[#d4c9ae]">
                  <strong className="text-[#f0d99e]">
                    Prototype preview:
                  </strong>{" "}

                </p>

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <MarketCard
                  label="NIFTY 50"
                  value="22,680.40"
                  change="+1.24%"
                  positive
                  icon={<TrendingUp size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="SENSEX"
                  value="74,512.30"
                  change="+0.86%"
                  positive
                  icon={<Activity size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="MARKET MOOD"
                  value="Positive"
                  change="Illustrative"
                  positive
                  icon={<Sparkles size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="DATA STATUS"
                  value="Sample data"
                  change="Not live"
                  positive={false}
                  icon={<ShieldCheck size={18} />}
                />
              </div>

              {/* CHART AND GUIDE */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 xl:grid-cols-3">

                {/* NIFTY CHART */}

                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 xl:col-span-2">
                  <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                        NIFTY 50 Overview
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999999]">
                        Illustrative index movement
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-1">
                      {periods.map((period) => (
                        <button
                          key={period}
                          onClick={() => setActivePeriod(period)}
                          className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition ${
                            activePeriod === period
                              ? "bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717]"
                              : "text-[#999999] hover:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {period}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mb-4">
                    <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
                      22,680.40
                    </span>

                    <span className="ml-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#75b798]">
                      +278.20 (+1.24%)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="h-[260px] w-full">
                    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                      <AreaChart data={chartData}>
                        <defs>
                          <linearGradient
                            id="marketGradient"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="0"
                            y2="1"
                          >
                            <stop
                              offset="0%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0.22}
                            />

                            <stop
                              offset="95%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0}
                            />
                          </linearGradient>
                        </defs>

                        <CartesianGrid
                          stroke="#ffffff"
                          strokeOpacity={0.07}
                          vertical={false}
                        />

                        <XAxis
                          dataKey="day"
                          axisLine={false}
                          tickLine={false}
                          tick={{ fill: "#999999", fontSize: 11 }}
                          dy={10}
                        />

                        <YAxis
                          domain={["dataMin - 150", "dataMax + 150"]}
                          orientation="right"
                          axisLine={false}
                          tickLine={false}
                          tick={{ fill: "#999999", fontSize: 10 }}
                          width={55}
                        />

                        <Tooltip
                          contentStyle={{
                            background: "#303030",
                            border: "1px solid #555555",
                            borderRadius: "10px",
                            color: "#fff",
                            fontSize: "12px",
                          }}
                        />

                        <Area
                          type="monotone"
                          dataKey="value"
                          stroke="#bdbdbd"
                          strokeWidth={2.5}
                          fill="url(#marketGradient)"
                          activeDot={{ r: 5, fill: "#eeeeee" }}
                        />
                      </AreaChart>
                    </ResponsiveContainer>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
                    Sample chart · Period selector is a UI preview; data is not
                    connected to a market feed.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* GREEDY GUIDE */}

                <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5">
                  <div className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-white/[0.03] blur-3xl" />

                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#383838] text-[#eeeeee]">
                      <Sparkles size={22} />
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs font-bold tracking-widest text-[#bdbdbd]">
                      YOUR MARKET GUIDE
                    </p>

                    <h3 className="mt-3 text-xl font-bold leading-7 text-[#eeeeee]">
                      The market can be complicated. Learning doesn&apos;t have to be.
                    </h3>

                    <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-6 text-[#a0a0a0]">
                      Ask questions about stocks, NIFTY 50, financial concepts
                      and investment research in simple language.
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-6 space-y-2">
                      {[
                        "What is NIFTY 50?",
                        "How do I analyse a stock?",
                        "Explain risk in simple words",
                      ].map((question) => (
                        <button
                          key={question}
                          onClick={() => {
                            router.push(
                              `/?question=${encodeURIComponent(question)}`
                            );
                          }}
                          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs text-[#d0d0d0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-white"
                        >
                          {question}

                          <ArrowUpRight
                            size={14}
                            className="text-[#aaaaaa]"
                          />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                      className="mt-5 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
                    >
                      <MessageSquare size={16} />
                      Start learning
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

// CHAT TYPES
