type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ul>
          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="pl-1 leading-7">
              {children}
            </li>
          ),

          hr: () => (
            <hr className="my-6 border-[#505050]" />
          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">
              {children}
            </blockquote>
          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {
            const isBlock = Boolean(className);

            return isBlock ? (
              <code className="block overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#dddddd]">
                {children}
              </code>
            ) : (
              <code className="rounded bg-[#414141] px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-[#eeeeee]">
                {children}
              </code>
            );
          },

          pre: ({ children }) => (
            <pre className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] p-4">
              {children}
            </pre>
          ),

          a: ({ children, href }) => (
            <a
              href={href}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#b8cfff] underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-white"
            >
              {children}
            </a>
          ),

          table: ({ children }) => (
            <div className="my-5 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141]">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left text-xs">
                {children}
              </table>
            </div>
          ),

          th: ({ children }) => (
            <th className="border-b border-[#505050] bg-[#303030] px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white">
              {children}
            </th>
          ),

          td: ({ children }) => (
            <td className="border-b border-[#414141] px-4 py-3">
              {children}
            </td>
          ),
        }}
      >
        {content}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">

              <div className="mb-7 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#212121] text-[#b4b4b4]">
                <MessageSquare size={26} />
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.035em] text-[#ececec] md:text-[32px]">
                What would you like to understand?
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-[13px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#999999]">
                Ask about NIFTY 50 companies, stock market concepts,
                historical performance, financial metrics and risk.
                GREEDY is here to make things simple.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-7 grid w-full gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="rounded-[26px] border border-[#424242] bg-[#212121] p-3 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.18)] transition duration-200 focus-within:border-[#666666]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={2}
                placeholder="Message GREEDY..."
                disabled={loading}
                className="max-h-40 min-h-10 w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pt-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#a0a0a0]">
                  Ask anything about the Indian stock market
                </p>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                  aria-label="Send message"
                  className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  <ArrowUp size={19} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS Â· Educational research only Â· Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT
// --------------------------------------------------

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] p-8 text-[#eeeeee]">
          Loading GREEDY STOCKS...
        </main>
      }
    >
      <HomeContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// REUSABLE MARKET CARD
// --------------------------------------------------

function MarketCard({
  label,
  value,
  change,
  positive,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  positive: boolean;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 transition hover:border-[#555555]">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-[#999999]">
          {label}
        </p>

        <span className="text-[#aaaaaa]">{icon}</span>
      </div>

      <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
        {value}
      </p>

      <p
        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
          positive ? "text-[#75b798]" : "text-[#d5b477]"
        }`}
      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// CHAT TYPES
// --------------------------------------------------

type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

// --------------------------------------------------
// MARKDOWN RESPONSE RENDERER
// --------------------------------------------------

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ul>
          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="pl-1 leading-7">
              {children}
            </li>
          ),

          hr: () => (
            <hr className="my-6 border-[#505050]" />
          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">
              {children}
            </blockquote>
          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {
            const isBlock = Boolean(className);

            return isBlock ? (
              <code className="block overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#dddddd]">
                {children}
              </code>
            ) : (
              <code className="rounded bg-[#414141] px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-[#eeeeee]">
                {children}
              </code>
            );
          },

          pre: ({ children }) => (
            <pre className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] p-4">
              {children}
            </pre>
          ),

          a: ({ children, href }) => (
            <a
              href={href}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#b8cfff] underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-white"
            >
              {children}
            </a>
          ),

          table: ({ children }) => (
            <div className="my-5 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141]">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left text-xs">
                {children}
              </table>
            </div>
          ),

          th: ({ children }) => (
            <th className="border-b border-[#505050] bg-[#303030] px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white">
              {children}
            </th>
          ),

          td: ({ children }) => (
            <td className="border-b border-[#414141] px-4 py-3">
              {children}
            </td>
          ),
        }}
      >
        {content}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="greedy-welcome flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">

              

              
<p className="greedy-welcome-tagline">
  Understand the market. <span>Question the numbers.</span> Build your conviction.
</p>

              

              <div className="greedy-welcome-suggestions hidden">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
{/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="greedy-composer greedy-welcome-composer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-[#353535] bg-[#1c1c1c] px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_5px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] transition-all duration-200 focus-within:border-[#555555]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={1}
                placeholder="Ask GREEDY"
                disabled={loading}
                className="greedy-composer-input max-h-40 min-h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent px-1 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                aria-label="Send message"
                className="greedy-send-button flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
              >
                <ArrowUp size={19} />
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS &middot; Educational research only &middot; Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT
// --------------------------------------------------

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const active = currentNav === item.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.name}
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation(item.name)}
                  title={sidebarCollapsed ? item.name : undefined}
                  aria-label={item.name}
                  className={`
                    flex items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left
                    text-sm transition
                    ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"}
                    ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-[#222222] font-medium text-[#ffffff]"
                        : "text-[#a0a0a0] hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-[#eeeeee]"
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <Icon size={19} className="shrink-0" />

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

          <div className={`mt-7 flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777]">
                Your chats
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={startNewChat}
                title="Start a new chat"
                aria-label="Start a new chat"
                className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-[#aaaaaa] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
              >
                <MessageSquare size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={startNewChat}
              className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#303030] px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] font-medium text-[#c8c8c8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#454545] hover:bg-[#202020] hover:text-white"
            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none">+</span>
              New Chat
            </button>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {historyLoading && conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#888888]">Loading chats...</p>
              ) : historyError ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-300">{historyError}</p>
              ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[#777777]">
                  Your saved conversations will appear here.
                </p>
              ) : (
                conversations.map((conversation) => {
                  const selected = parsedConversationId === conversation.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={conversation.id}
                      className={`group flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg transition duration-200 ${
                        selected ? "bg-[#303030]" : "hover:bg-[#2a2a2a]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openConversation(conversation.id)}
                        title={conversation.title}
                        className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 text-left"
                      >
                        <span className="block truncate text-xs text-[#dddddd]">
                          {conversation.title || "New conversation"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-[#777777]">
                          {conversation.message_count} messages
                        </span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => void removeConversation(conversation.id)}
                        title="Delete conversation"
                        aria-label={`Delete ${conversation.title || "conversation"}`}
                        className="mr-1 rounded-lg p-2 text-[#777777] opacity-100 transition hover:bg-[#414141] hover:text-red-300 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100"
                      >
                        <X size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SIDEBAR FOOTER */}

          <div className="mt-auto">
            <div
              className={`mb-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-4 ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[#eeeeee]">
                <Sparkles size={16} />

                <span className="text-xs font-bold">
                  YOUR MARKET GUIDE
                </span>
              </div>

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import numbers
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from financial_metrics import calculate_metrics


def _validate_positive_integer(value: int, name: str) -> None:
    if (
        isinstance(value, bool)
        or not isinstance(value, numbers.Integral)
        or value <= 0
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive integer.")


def _validate_risk_free_rate(rate: float) -> None:
    if (
        isinstance(rate, bool)
        or not isinstance(rate, numbers.Real)
        or not math.isfinite(float(rate))
        or rate <= -1
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Annual risk-free rate must be finite and greater than -100%."
        )


def _validate_datetime_index(index: pd.Index, name: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use a DatetimeIndex.")

    if index.hasnans:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot contain NaT dates.")

    if index.has_duplicates:
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate {name} dates found.")


def _validate_matching_timezones(
    first: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    second: pd.DatetimeIndex,
) -> None:
    first_tz = str(first.tz) if first.tz is not None else None
    second_tz = str(second.tz) if second.tz is not None else None

    if first_tz != second_tz:
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio and benchmark dates must use the same timezone."
        )


def _validate_finite_numeric_series(
    values: pd.Series,
    name: str,
) -> pd.Series:
    result = pd.to_numeric(values, errors="coerce")

    numeric_values = result.dropna()

    if not numeric_values.map(
        lambda value: math.isfinite(float(value))
    ).all():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values.")

    return result.astype(float)


def validate_portfolio(
    symbols: list[str],
    sectors: dict[str, str],
    max_stocks: int = 10,
    max_per_sector: int = 3,
) -> None:
    """Validate the stock selection and sector constraints."""

    _validate_positive_integer(max_stocks, "max_stocks")
    _validate_positive_integer(max_per_sector, "max_per_sector")

    if not isinstance(symbols, (list, tuple)):
        raise ValueError("symbols must be a list or tuple.")

    if not isinstance(sectors, dict):
        raise ValueError("sectors must be a dictionary.")

    if not symbols:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one stock.")

    if any(
        not isinstance(symbol, str) or not symbol.strip()
        for symbol in symbols
    ):
        raise ValueError("Stock symbols must be non-empty strings.")

    if len(symbols) != len(set(symbols)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate stock symbols are not allowed.")

    if len(symbols) > max_stocks:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Portfolio cannot contain more than {max_stocks} stocks."
        )

    missing = [symbol for symbol in symbols if symbol not in sectors]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing sector information for: {missing}"
        )

    invalid_sectors = [
        symbol
        for symbol in symbols
        if not isinstance(sectors[symbol], str)
        or not sectors[symbol].strip()
    ]

    if invalid_sectors:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid sector information for: {invalid_sectors}"
        )

    sector_counts = pd.Series(
        [sectors[symbol] for symbol in symbols]
    ).value_counts()

    violations = sector_counts[
        sector_counts > max_per_sector
    ]

    if not violations.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Maximum {max_per_sector} stocks per sector exceeded: "
            f"{violations.to_dict()}"
        )


def calculate_portfolio(
    prices,
    sectors,
    symbols=None,
    risk_free_rate=0.0,
    max_stocks=10,
    max_per_sector=3,
    price_basis="RAW_CLOSE_UNADJUSTED",
    return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Calculate an equal-weight, daily-rebalanced portfolio.

    Input:
        prices: Date-indexed closing prices, one column per stock.
        sectors: Mapping of stock symbol to sector.
        symbols: Selected stock symbols. Defaults to all price columns.
        risk_free_rate: Annual risk-free rate for Sharpe ratio.
        max_stocks: Maximum number of stocks in the portfolio.
        max_per_sector: Maximum number of stocks per sector.
        price_basis: Basis for price calculations.
        return_type: Type of returns to calculate.

    Missing observations are not filled. Only dates with valid returns
    for every selected stock are used.

    Equal weights are reset every session, representing daily
    rebalancing rather than buy-and-hold.
    """

    _validate_risk_free_rate(risk_free_rate)
    _validate_positive_integer(max_stocks, "max_stocks")
    _validate_positive_integer(max_per_sector, "max_per_sector")

    if not isinstance(prices, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("prices must be a pandas DataFrame.")

    if prices.empty:
        raise ValueError("Price dataset is empty.")

    if not isinstance(price_basis, str) or not price_basis.strip():
        raise ValueError("price_basis must be a non-empty string.")

    if not isinstance(return_type, str) or not return_type.strip():
        raise ValueError("return_type must be a non-empty string.")

    selected = (
        list(prices.columns)
        if symbols is None
        else list(symbols)
    )

    validate_portfolio(
        selected,
        sectors,
        max_stocks=max_stocks,
        max_per_sector=max_per_sector,
    )

    missing_columns = [
        symbol for symbol in selected
        if symbol not in prices.columns
    ]

    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Price columns missing for: {missing_columns}"
        )

    data = prices[selected].copy()

    try:
        converted_index = pd.DatetimeIndex(
            pd.to_datetime(data.index, errors="raise")
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio dates must be valid datetime values."
        ) from exc

    _validate_datetime_index(converted_index, "portfolio trading")

    data.index = converted_index
    data = data.sort_index()

    data = data.apply(
        lambda column: pd.to_numeric(column, errors="coerce")
    )

    # Missing observations remain missing; never forward-fill them.
    values = data.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    observed_values = values[~pd.isna(values)]

    if not all(math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in observed_values):
        raise ValueError("Observed prices must be finite.")

    if (observed_values <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Observed prices must be positive.")

    # No forward-fill or synthetic prices.
    stock_returns = data.pct_change(fill_method=None)

    # Require all selected stocks to have valid returns on a date.
    aligned_returns = stock_returns.dropna(how="any")

    if len(aligned_returns) < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "Insufficient aligned return observations."
        )

    if not aligned_returns.map(
        lambda value: math.isfinite(float(value))
    ).all().all():
        raise ValueError("Portfolio returns must be finite.")

    if (aligned_returns <= -1).any().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Stock returns cannot be less than or equal to -100%."
        )

    weights = {
        symbol: 1.0 / len(selected)
        for symbol in selected
    }

    # Equal weights are reset every session:
    # daily rebalancing assumption.
    portfolio_returns = aligned_returns.mul(
        pd.Series(weights)
    ).sum(axis=1).rename("portfolio")

    if not portfolio_returns.map(math.isfinite).all():
        raise ValueError("Portfolio returns must be finite.")

    cumulative_values = (
        (1 + portfolio_returns).cumprod() * 100
    )

    if not cumulative_values.map(math.isfinite).all():
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio value calculation produced non-finite values."
        )

    # Include the starting portfolio value immediately before
    # the first valid return.
    first_return_date = portfolio_returns.index[0]

    prior_dates = data.index[
        data.index < first_return_date
    ]

    if prior_dates.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "Cannot establish a starting portfolio value."
        )

    baseline_date = prior_dates[-1]

    portfolio_values = pd.concat([
        pd.Series(
            [100.0],
            index=pd.DatetimeIndex([baseline_date]),
        ),
        cumulative_values,
    ])

    portfolio_values.name = "portfolio_value"

    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        portfolio_values,
        risk_free_rate=risk_free_rate,
        price_basis=price_basis,
        return_type=return_type,
    )

    correlation = aligned_returns.corr()

    sector_weights: dict[str, float] = {}

    for symbol, weight in weights.items():
        sector = sectors[symbol]
        sector_weights[sector] = (
            sector_weights.get(sector, 0.0) + weight
        )

    return {
        "symbols": selected,
        "weights": weights,
        "sector_allocation": sector_weights,
        "portfolio_values": portfolio_values,
        "daily_returns": portfolio_returns,
        "stock_returns": aligned_returns,
        "correlation": correlation,
        "metrics": metrics,
        "metadata": {
            "method": "EQUAL_WEIGHT",
            "rebalancing": "DAILY",
            "risk_free_rate": risk_free_rate,
            "price_basis": price_basis,
            "return_type": return_type,
            "dividend_adjusted": False,
            "corporate_action_coverage": "PARTIAL",
            "input_price_observations": len(data),
            "aligned_return_observations": len(aligned_returns),
            "excluded_return_dates": (
                len(stock_returns) - len(aligned_returns)
            ),
            "missing_values_filled": False,
            "database_writes": False,
        },
    }


def compare_with_benchmark(
    portfolio_returns: pd.Series,
    benchmark_prices: pd.Series,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compare portfolio and benchmark on common return dates.

    Portfolio returns must be daily simple returns expressed as decimals.
    Benchmark input must contain positive closing prices.
    """

    if not isinstance(portfolio_returns, pd.Series):
        raise ValueError(
            "portfolio_returns must be a pandas Series."
        )

    if not isinstance(benchmark_prices, pd.Series):
        raise ValueError(
            "benchmark_prices must be a pandas Series."
        )

    if portfolio_returns.empty or benchmark_prices.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio returns and benchmark prices cannot be empty."
        )

    _validate_datetime_index(
        portfolio_returns.index,
        "portfolio return",
    )

    _validate_datetime_index(
        benchmark_prices.index,
        "benchmark trading",
    )

    _validate_matching_timezones(
        portfolio_returns.index,
        benchmark_prices.index,
    )

    portfolio = _validate_finite_numeric_series(
        portfolio_returns,
        "Portfolio returns",
    ).sort_index()

    benchmark = _validate_finite_numeric_series(
        benchmark_prices,
        "Benchmark prices",
    ).sort_index()

    if portfolio.isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio returns cannot contain missing values."
        )

    if (portfolio <= -1).any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio returns cannot be less than or equal to -100%."
        )

    if benchmark.isna().any() or (benchmark <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Benchmark prices must be positive and finite."
        )

    benchmark_returns = benchmark.pct_change(
        fill_method=None
    ).dropna()

    if not benchmark_returns.map(math.isfinite).all():
        raise ValueError("Benchmark returns must be finite.")

    comparison = pd.concat(
        [
            portfolio.rename("portfolio"),
            benchmark_returns.rename("benchmark"),
        ],
        axis=1,
        join="inner",
    ).dropna()

    if len(comparison) < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "Insufficient common portfolio and benchmark dates."
        )

    portfolio_growth = (
        (1 + comparison["portfolio"]).prod() - 1
    )

    benchmark_growth = (
        (1 + comparison["benchmark"]).prod() - 1
    )

    if not (
        math.isfinite(float(portfolio_growth))
        and math.isfinite(float(benchmark_growth))
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Benchmark comparison produced non-finite returns."
        )

    return {
        "portfolio_return_pct": float(
            portfolio_growth * 100
        ),
        "benchmark_return_pct": float(
            benchmark_growth * 100
        ),
        "excess_return_pct": float(
            (portfolio_growth - benchmark_growth) * 100
        ),
        "common_return_observations": len(comparison),
        "comparison_returns": comparison,
        "benchmark_basis": "NIFTY_50_PRICE_RETURN",
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import numbers
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from financial_metrics import calculate_metrics


def _validate_positive_integer(value: int, name: str) -> None:
    if (
        isinstance(value, bool)
        or not isinstance(value, numbers.Integral)
        or value <= 0
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive integer.")


def _validate_risk_free_rate(rate: float) -> None:
    if (
        isinstance(rate, bool)
        or not isinstance(rate, numbers.Real)
        or not math.isfinite(float(rate))
        or rate <= -1
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Annual risk-free rate must be finite and greater than -100%."
        )


def _validate_datetime_index(index: pd.Index, name: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use a DatetimeIndex.")

    if index.hasnans:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot contain NaT dates.")

    if index.has_duplicates:
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate {name} dates found.")


def _validate_matching_timezones(
    first: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    second: pd.DatetimeIndex,
) -> None:
    first_tz = str(first.tz) if first.tz is not None else None
    second_tz = str(second.tz) if second.tz is not None else None

    if first_tz != second_tz:
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio and benchmark dates must use the same timezone."
        )


def _validate_finite_numeric_series(
    values: pd.Series,
    name: str,
) -> pd.Series:
    result = pd.to_numeric(values, errors="coerce")

    numeric_values = result.dropna()

    if not numeric_values.map(
        lambda value: math.isfinite(float(value))
    ).all():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values.")

    return result.astype(float)


def validate_portfolio(
    symbols: list[str],
    sectors: dict[str, str],
    max_stocks: int = 10,
    max_per_sector: int = 3,
) -> None:
    """Validate the stock selection and sector constraints."""

    _validate_positive_integer(max_stocks, "max_stocks")
    _validate_positive_integer(max_per_sector, "max_per_sector")

    if not isinstance(symbols, (list, tuple)):
        raise ValueError("symbols must be a list or tuple.")

    if not isinstance(sectors, dict):
        raise ValueError("sectors must be a dictionary.")

    if not symbols:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one stock.")

    if any(
        not isinstance(symbol, str) or not symbol.strip()
        for symbol in symbols
    ):
        raise ValueError("Stock symbols must be non-empty strings.")

    if len(symbols) != len(set(symbols)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate stock symbols are not allowed.")

    if len(symbols) > max_stocks:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Portfolio cannot contain more than {max_stocks} stocks."
        )

    missing = [symbol for symbol in symbols if symbol not in sectors]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing sector information for: {missing}"
        )

    invalid_sectors = [
        symbol
        for symbol in symbols
        if not isinstance(sectors[symbol], str)
        or not sectors[symbol].strip()
    ]

    if invalid_sectors:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid sector information for: {invalid_sectors}"
        )

    sector_counts = pd.Series(
        [sectors[symbol] for symbol in symbols]
    ).value_counts()

    violations = sector_counts[
        sector_counts > max_per_sector
    ]

    if not violations.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Maximum {max_per_sector} stocks per sector exceeded: "
            f"{violations.to_dict()}"
        )


def calculate_portfolio(
    prices,
    sectors,
    symbols=None,
    risk_free_rate=0.0,
    max_stocks=10,
    max_per_sector=3,
    price_basis="RAW_CLOSE_UNADJUSTED",
    return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Calculate an equal-weight, daily-rebalanced portfolio.

    Input:
        prices: Date-indexed closing prices, one column per stock.
        sectors: Mapping of stock symbol to sector.
        symbols: Selected stock symbols. Defaults to all price columns.
        risk_free_rate: Annual risk-free rate for Sharpe ratio.
        max_stocks: Maximum number of stocks in the portfolio.
        max_per_sector: Maximum number of stocks per sector.
        price_basis: Basis for price calculations.
        return_type: Type of returns to calculate.

    Missing observations are not filled. Only dates with valid returns
    for every selected stock are used.

    Equal weights are reset every session, representing daily
    rebalancing rather than buy-and-hold.
    """

    _validate_risk_free_rate(risk_free_rate)
    _validate_positive_integer(max_stocks, "max_stocks")
    _validate_positive_integer(max_per_sector, "max_per_sector")

    if not isinstance(prices, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("prices must be a pandas DataFrame.")

    if prices.empty:
        raise ValueError("Price dataset is empty.")

    if not isinstance(price_basis, str) or not price_basis.strip():
        raise ValueError("price_basis must be a non-empty string.")

    if not isinstance(return_type, str) or not return_type.strip():
        raise ValueError("return_type must be a non-empty string.")

    selected = (
        list(prices.columns)
        if symbols is None
        else list(symbols)
    )

    validate_portfolio(
        selected,
        sectors,
        max_stocks=max_stocks,
        max_per_sector=max_per_sector,
    )

    missing_columns = [
        symbol for symbol in selected
        if symbol not in prices.columns
    ]

    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Price columns missing for: {missing_columns}"
        )

    data = prices[selected].copy()

    try:
        converted_index = pd.DatetimeIndex(
            pd.to_datetime(data.index, errors="raise")
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio dates must be valid datetime values."
        ) from exc

    _validate_datetime_index(converted_index, "portfolio trading")

    data.index = converted_index
    data = data.sort_index()

    data = data.apply(
        lambda column: pd.to_numeric(column, errors="coerce")
    )

    # Missing observations remain missing; never forward-fill them.
    values = data.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    observed_values = values[~pd.isna(values)]

    if not all(math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in observed_values):
        raise ValueError("Observed prices must be finite.")

    if (observed_values <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Observed prices must be positive.")

    # No forward-fill or synthetic prices.
    stock_returns = data.pct_change(fill_method=None)

    # Require all selected stocks to have valid returns on a date.
    aligned_returns = stock_returns.dropna(how="any")

    if len(aligned_returns) < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "Insufficient aligned return observations."
        )

    if not aligned_returns.map(
        lambda value: math.isfinite(float(value))
    ).all().all():
        raise ValueError("Portfolio returns must be finite.")

    if (aligned_returns <= -1).any().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Stock returns cannot be less than or equal to -100%."
        )

    weights = {
        symbol: 1.0 / len(selected)
        for symbol in selected
    }

    # Equal weights are reset every session:
    # daily rebalancing assumption.
    portfolio_returns = aligned_returns.mul(
        pd.Series(weights)
    ).sum(axis=1).rename("portfolio")

    if not portfolio_returns.map(math.isfinite).all():
        raise ValueError("Portfolio returns must be finite.")

    cumulative_values = (
        (1 + portfolio_returns).cumprod() * 100
    )

    if not cumulative_values.map(math.isfinite).all():
        raise ValueError(
            "Portfolio value calculation produced non-finite values."
        )

    # Include the starting portfolio value immediately before
    # the first valid return.
    first_return_date = portfolio_returns.index[0]

    prior_dates = data.index[
        data.index < first_return_date
    ]

    if prior_dates.empty:
        raise ValueError(
            "Cannot establish a starting portfolio value."
        )

    baseline_date = prior_dates[-1]

    portfolio_values = pd.concat([
        pd.Series(
            [100.0],
            index=pd.DatetimeIndex([baseline_date]),
        ),
        cumulative_values,
    ])

    portfolio_values.name = "portfolio_value"

    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        portfolio_values,
        risk_free_rate=risk_free_rate,
        price_basis=price_basis,
        return_type=return_type,
    )

    correlation = aligned_returns.corr()

    sector_weights: dict[str, float] = {}

    for symbol, weight in weights.items():
        sector = sectors[symbol]
        sector_weights[sector] = (
            sector_weights.get(sector, 0.0) + weight
        )

    return {
        "symbols": selected,
        "weights": weights,
        "sector_allocation": sector_weights,
        "portfolio_values": portfolio_values,
        "daily_returns": portfolio_returns,
        "stock_returns": aligned_returns,
        "correlation": correlation,
        "metrics": metrics,
        "metadata": {
            "method": "EQUAL_WEIGHT",
            "rebalancing": "DAILY",
            "risk_free_rate": risk_free_rate,
            "price_basis": price_basis,
            "return_type": return_type,
            "dividend_adjusted": False,
            "corporate_action_coverage": "PARTIAL",
            "input_price_observations": len(data),
            "aligned_return_observations": len(aligned_returns),
            "excluded_return_dates": (
                len(stock_returns) - len(aligned_returns)
            ),
            "missing_values_filled": False,
            "database_writes": False,
        },
    }

          hr: () => (

          ),
