                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* MAIN CONTENT */}

        <section className="min-w-0 flex-1">

          {/* TOP HEADER: HIDDEN ON ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav !== "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-[76px] items-center justify-between border-b border-[#303030] bg-[#000000]/95 px-4 backdrop-blur-xl md:px-7">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                {/* MOBILE SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

                <button
                  onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
                  className="rounded-lg p-2 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white lg:hidden"
                  aria-label="Open sidebar"
                  title="Open sidebar"
                >
                  <Menu size={20} />
                </button>

                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                    {currentNav}
                  </p>

                  <p className="hidden text-[11px] text-[#888888] sm:block">
                    Your personal Indian stock market learning space
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#2a2a2a] px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] sm:flex">
                  <Search size={15} />

                  Search stocks

                  <span className="text-[#777777]">âŒ˜ K</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  aria-label="Notifications"
                  className="rounded-xl border border-[#414141] p-2.5 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <Bell size={17} />
                </button>

                <div className="hidden h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#383838] text-xs font-bold text-white sm:flex">
                  GS
                </div>
              </div>
            </header>
          ) : (
            /* MOBILE MENU ACCESS FOR ASK GREEDY */

            <button
              onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
              aria-label="Open sidebar"
              className="fixed left-3 top-3 z-30 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#303030] text-white shadow-lg lg:hidden"
            >
              {mobileMenu ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
            </button>
          )}

          {/* ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav === "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <AskGreedyChat
              key={`ask-greedy-chat-${parsedConversationId ?? "new"}`}
              initialQuestion={questionFromUrl}
              initialConversationId={parsedConversationId}
              onConversationUpdated={() => void refreshConversations()}
            />
          ) : currentNav === "Explore & Discover" ? (
            <ExploreDiscover />
) : currentNav === "Portfolio Builder" ? (
            <PortfolioBuilder initialSelectedStock={stockFromUrl} />
          ) : currentNav === "Learn" ? (
            <LearnPage />
          ) : (

            /* DASHBOARD */

            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] p-5 md:p-8">

              {/* DASHBOARD HEADING */}

              <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#b0b0b0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    YOUR MARKET LEARNING DASHBOARD
                  </div>

                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee] md:text-3xl">
                    Understand the market.{" "}
                    <span className="text-[#999999]">
                      Think smarter.
                    </span>
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999999]">
                    Explore NIFTY 50, discover opportunities and learn investing.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
                >
                  <MessageSquare size={16} />
                  Ask GREEDY
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* DATA NOTICE */}

              <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#555044] bg-[#302d25] p-3.5">
                <Activity
                  className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#e2c98a]"
                  size={17}
                />

                <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-[#d4c9ae]">
                  <strong className="text-[#f0d99e]">
                    Prototype preview:
                  </strong>{" "}
                  All market values and chart points on this screen are illustrative
                  sample data, not live market prices or investment recommendations.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* MARKET CARDS */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <MarketCard
                  label="NIFTY 50"
                  value="22,680.40"
                  change="+1.24%"
                  positive
                  icon={<TrendingUp size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="SENSEX"
                  value="74,512.30"
                  change="+0.86%"
                  positive
                  icon={<Activity size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="MARKET MOOD"
                  value="Positive"
                  change="Illustrative"
                  positive
                  icon={<Sparkles size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="DATA STATUS"
                  value="Sample data"
                  change="Not live"
                  positive={false}
                  icon={<ShieldCheck size={18} />}
                />
              </div>

              {/* CHART AND GUIDE */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 xl:grid-cols-3">

                {/* NIFTY CHART */}

                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 xl:col-span-2">
                  <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                        NIFTY 50 Overview
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999999]">
                        Illustrative index movement
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-1">
                      {periods.map((period) => (
                        <button
                          key={period}
                          onClick={() => setActivePeriod(period)}
                          className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition ${
                            activePeriod === period
                              ? "bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717]"
                              : "text-[#999999] hover:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {period}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mb-4">
                    <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
                      22,680.40
                    </span>

                    <span className="ml-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#75b798]">
                      +278.20 (+1.24%)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="h-[260px] w-full">
                    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                      <AreaChart data={chartData}>
                        <defs>
                          <linearGradient
                            id="marketGradient"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="0"
                            y2="1"
                          >
                            <stop
                              offset="0%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0.22}
                            />

                            <stop
                              offset="95%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0}

      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  Wallet,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

type Holding = {
  symbol: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  invested: number;
  weight: number;
  sector?: string;
};

type PeriodResult = {
  start?: string;
  end?: string;
  observations?: number;
  metrics?: {
    period_return_pct?: number;
    cagr_pct?: number;
    annualized_volatility_pct?: number;
    maximum_drawdown_pct?: number;
    sharpe_ratio?: number;
  };
  benchmark?: {
    portfolio_return_pct?: number;
    benchmark_return_pct?: number;
    excess_return_pct?: number;
  };
};

type PortfolioResult = {
  status: string;
  selection_method: string;
  portfolio: {
    capital: number;
    invested: number;
    cash_remaining: number;
    stock_count: number;
    holdings: Holding[];
  };
  selection_log: {
    step: number;
    symbol: string;
    portfolio_sharpe: number;
    marginal_sharpe_change: number | null;
  }[];
  training: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    observations: number;
    selection_sharpe: number;
  };
  validation: PeriodResult;
  test: PeriodResult;
  data_limitations: {
    historical_membership_survivorship_bias?: boolean;
    dividend_adjusted?: boolean;
    corporate_action_coverage?: string;
    validation_test_missing_prices_filled?: boolean;
  };
  assumptions: {
    selection_method: string;
    daily_rebalancing: boolean;
    selection_uses_training_data_only: boolean;
    globally_optimal: boolean;
  };
};

const money = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number"
    ? value.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
      })
    : "?";

const pct = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number" ? `${value.toFixed(2)}%` : "?";

function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#000000] p-4">
      <p className="text-xs text-[#a3a3a3]">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-white">{value}</p>
      {detail && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#888]">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Performance({
  title,
  period,
}: {
  title: string;
  period: PeriodResult;
}) {
  const m = period.metrics;
  const b = period.benchmark;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#171717] p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-[#999]">
          {period.start ?? "?"} to {period.end ?? "?"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Metric label="Period return" value={pct(m?.period_return_pct)} />
        <Metric label="CAGR" value={pct(m?.cagr_pct)} />
        <Metric label="Sharpe ratio" value={m?.sharpe_ratio?.toFixed(3) ?? "?"} />
        <Metric
          label="Annualized volatility"
          value={pct(m?.annualized_volatility_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Maximum drawdown"
          value={pct(m?.maximum_drawdown_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="NIFTY 50 return"
          value={pct(b?.benchmark_return_pct)}
          detail={`Excess return: ${pct(b?.excess_return_pct)}`}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function PortfolioBuilder({ initialSelectedStock = "" }: { initialSelectedStock?: string }) {
  const [capital, setCapital] = useState("100000");
  const [stockCount, setStockCount] = useState("5");
  const [maxPerSector, setMaxPerSector] = useState("3");
  const [trainingYears, setTrainingYears] = useState("10");
  const [riskFreeRate, setRiskFreeRate] = useState("0");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PortfolioResult | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [addedStocks, setAddedStocks] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = "greedy-stocks-selected";
    let saved: string[] = [];

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        saved = parsed.filter(
          (item): item is string => typeof item === "string"
        ).map((item) => item.toUpperCase());
      }
    } catch {
      saved = [];
    }

    const merged = Array.from(new Set([
      ...saved,
      ...(initialSelectedStock ? [initialSelectedStock.toUpperCase()] : []),
    ]));

    setAddedStocks(merged);
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(merged));
  }, [initialSelectedStock]);

  function removeAddedStock(symbol: string) {
    const updated = addedStocks.filter((item) => item !== symbol);
    setAddedStocks(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("greedy-stocks-selected", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  async function generatePortfolio(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/portfolio/generate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          capital: Number(capital),
          stock_count: Number(stockCount),
          training_years: Number(trainingYears),
          max_per_sector: Number(maxPerSector),
          risk_free_rate: Number(riskFreeRate) / 100,
          selected_symbols: addedStocks,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          typeof data.detail === "string"
            ? data.detail
            : JSON.stringify(data.detail ?? "Portfolio generation failed.")
        );
      }

      setResult(data as PortfolioResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Could not connect to GREEDY STOCKS API."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6 p-5 md:p-8">
      <header>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#aaa]">
          <BriefcaseBusiness size={15} />
          GREEDY V2 PORTFOLIO ENGINE
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
          Portfolio Builder
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-[#aaa]">
          Generate a whole-share portfolio using sequential greedy Sharpe
          selection and evaluate it against NIFTY 50.
        </p>
      </header>

      {addedStocks.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
              Your selected stocks
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-cyan-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200">
              {addedStocks.length} {addedStocks.length === 1 ? "stock" : "stocks"} saved
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {addedStocks.map((symbol) => (
              <span key={symbol} className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-cyan-200">
                {symbol}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => removeAddedStock(symbol)}
                  aria-label={`Remove ${symbol}`}
                  className="text-lg leading-none text-cyan-200/70 transition hover:text-red-300"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[#aaa]">
            Your research list is saved in this browser and survives navigation and refreshes.
            These stocks stay in your portfolio. Greedy V2 selects the remaining slots.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
      <form
        onSubmit={generatePortfolio}
        className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5"
      >
        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Investment capital (INR)
          <input
            required
            type="number"
            min="1"
            max="100000000000"
            step="0.01"
            value={capital}
            onChange={(e) => setCapital(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-[#888]"
          />
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Number of stocks
          <select
            value={stockCount}
            onChange={(e) => setStockCount(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} stocks</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Maximum stocks per sector
          <select
            value={maxPerSector}
            onChange={(e) => setMaxPerSector(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Training history
          <select
            value={trainingYears}
            onChange={(e) => setTrainingYears(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} years</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Annual risk-free rate (%)
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            max="100"
            step="0.1"
            value={riskFreeRate}
            onChange={(e) => setRiskFreeRate(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          />
        </label>

        <div className="flex items-end md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-5">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-black transition hover:bg-[#ddd] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:w-auto"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <RefreshCw size={17} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <TrendingUp size={17} />
            )}
            {loading ? "Generating portfolio..." : "Generate Greedy V2 Portfolio"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-red-950/30 p-4 text-sm text-red-300">
          <AlertTriangle size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!result && !loading && !error && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#444] p-10 text-center">
          <Wallet size={30} className="mx-auto text-[#888]" />
          <h3 className="mt-3 font-semibold text-white">
            Your portfolio will appear here
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999]">
            Choose stocks you want to keep. Greedy V2 fills the remaining slots.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <>
          <section className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <Metric label="Starting capital" value={money(result.portfolio.capital)} />
            <Metric label="Amount invested" value={money(result.portfolio.invested)} />
            <Metric label="Cash remaining" value={money(result.portfolio.cash_remaining)} />
            <Metric
              label="Selected stocks"
              value={String(result.portfolio.stock_count)}
              detail="Whole-share allocation"
            />
          </section>

          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]">
            <div className="border-b border-[#303030] p-5">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Your holdings</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999]">
                Latest available raw closing prices; quantities are whole shares.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[650px] text-left text-sm">
                <thead className="bg-[#292929] text-xs text-[#aaa]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Stock</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Sector</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Price</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Quantity</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Investment</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Weight</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {result.portfolio.holdings.map((holding) => (
                    <tr key={holding.symbol} className="border-t border-[#353535] text-[#eee]">
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 font-semibold">{holding.symbol}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-[#aaa]">{holding.sector ?? "?"}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{money(holding.price)}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{holding.quantity}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{money(holding.invested)}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{(holding.weight * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Greedy selection journey</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999]">
              Training period: {result.training.start} to {result.training.end}
              {" ? "}{result.training.observations.toLocaleString("en-IN")} observations
              {" ? "}Selection Sharpe: {result.training.selection_sharpe.toFixed(3)}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              {result.selection_log.map((step) => (
                <div key={step.step} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[#292929] p-3 text-sm">
                  <div>
                    <span className="mr-3 text-[#888]">#{step.step}</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-white">{step.symbol}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right text-[#bbb]">
                    Sharpe {step.portfolio_sharpe.toFixed(3)}
                    {step.marginal_sharpe_change !== null && (
                      <span className={step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "ml-3 text-green-400" : "ml-3 text-red-400"}>
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change.toFixed(3)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
            <Performance title="Validation performance" period={result.validation} />
            <Performance title="Out-of-sample test performance" period={result.test} />
          </div>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Methodology and data limitations</h2>
            <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2 text-sm text-[#bbb] md:grid-cols-2">
              <li>? Selection method: {result.assumptions.selection_method}</li>
              <li>? Daily rebalancing: {result.assumptions.daily_rebalancing ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Selection uses training data only: {result.assumptions.selection_uses_training_data_only ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Globally optimal: {result.assumptions.globally_optimal ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Dividend adjusted: {result.data_limitations.dividend_adjusted ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Corporate-action coverage: {result.data_limitations.corporate_action_coverage ?? "Not specified"}</li>
              <li>? Survivorship bias: {result.data_limitations.historical_membership_survivorship_bias ? "Present" : "Not flagged"}</li>
              <li>? Missing evaluation prices filled: {result.data_limitations.validation_test_missing_prices_filled ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-[#303030] pt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#999]">
              Historical validation and test metrics represent a daily-rebalanced,
              equal-weight research portfolio. They are not the realized buy-and-hold
              performance of the whole-share holdings shown above. Historical results
              do not guarantee future returns. For educational research only, not
              investment advice.
            </p>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

"""Greedy V2 — sequential portfolio selection engine.

This module selects stocks using ONLY the price history supplied to it.
The caller is responsible for passing training-period prices, never
validation or test-period prices.

Method:
- Equal-weight portfolio.
- Sequential greedy selection.
- Maximise historical annualised Sharpe ratio.
- Maximum 10 stocks.
- Maximum 3 stocks per sector.
- Risk-free rate defaults to 0%.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import Any

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

ANALYTICS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

if str(ANALYTICS_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ANALYTICS_DIR))

from portfolio_analytics import calculate_portfolio


def greedy_select_stocks(
    train_prices: pd.DataFrame,
    sectors: dict[str, str],
    target_stocks: int = 10,
    max_per_sector: int = 3,
    risk_free_rate: float = 0.0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Select stocks sequentially using training-period Sharpe ratio."""

    if not isinstance(train_prices, pd.DataFrame):
        raise TypeError("train_prices must be a pandas DataFrame.")

    if train_prices.empty:
        raise ValueError("Training price data is empty.")

    if not isinstance(train_prices.index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
        raise ValueError("Training prices require a DatetimeIndex.")

    if train_prices.index.tz is not None:
        raise ValueError("Training dates must not contain a timezone.")

    if train_prices.index.has_duplicates:
        raise ValueError("Duplicate training dates detected.")

    if not train_prices.columns.is_unique:
        raise ValueError("Duplicate stock symbols detected.")

    if len(train_prices) < 60:
        raise ValueError("At least 60 price observations are required.")

    if not isinstance(target_stocks, int) or isinstance(target_stocks, bool):
        raise ValueError("target_stocks must be an integer.")

    if not isinstance(max_per_sector, int) or isinstance(max_per_sector, bool):
        raise ValueError("max_per_sector must be an integer.")

    if target_stocks < 1:
        raise ValueError("target_stocks must be at least 1.")

    if max_per_sector < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_per_sector must be at least 1.")

    if target_stocks > len(train_prices.columns):
        raise ValueError("Target exceeds the available number of stocks.")

    if not math.isfinite(float(risk_free_rate)):
        raise ValueError("risk_free_rate must be finite.")

    if risk_free_rate < 0:
        raise ValueError("risk_free_rate cannot be negative.")

    prices = train_prices.copy().sort_index()

    prices = prices.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

    if prices.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Training prices contain missing or invalid values. "
            "Do not fill or silently remove them."
        )

    if (prices <= 0).any().any():
        raise ValueError("Training prices must be positive.")

    symbols = list(prices.columns)

    missing_sectors = [
        symbol
        for symbol in symbols
        if symbol not in sectors
        or not isinstance(sectors[symbol], str)
        or not sectors[symbol].strip()
    ]

    if missing_sectors:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing sector classifications: {missing_sectors}"
        )

    sector_capacity = sum(
        min(
            max_per_sector,
            sum(
                sectors[symbol] == sector
                for symbol in symbols
            ),
        )
        for sector in set(sectors.values())
    )

    if target_stocks > sector_capacity:
        raise ValueError(
            "Target cannot be reached under the sector constraint."
        )

    selected: list[str] = []
    selection_log: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    print("\nGREEDY STOCKS — V2 SELECTION ENGINE")
    print("=" * 65)
    print("Available candidates:", len(symbols))
    print("Target portfolio size:", target_stocks)
    print("Maximum stocks per sector:", max_per_sector)
    print("Risk-free rate:", risk_free_rate)
    print("Training observations:", len(prices))
    print("Training dates:", prices.index.min().date(), "to", prices.index.max().date())

    # Sequential greedy selection.
    for step in range(1, target_stocks + 1):

        candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        for symbol in symbols:

            if symbol in selected:
                continue

            current_sector_count = sum(
                sectors[item] == sectors[symbol]
                for item in selected
            )

            if current_sector_count >= max_per_sector:
                continue

            trial_symbols = selected + [symbol]

            result = calculate_portfolio(
                prices=prices,
                sectors=sectors,
                symbols=trial_symbols,
                risk_free_rate=risk_free_rate,
                max_stocks=target_stocks,
                max_per_sector=max_per_sector,
            )

            sharpe = result["metrics"].get("sharpe_ratio")

            if sharpe is None or pd.isna(sharpe):
                continue

            sharpe = float(sharpe)

            if not math.isfinite(sharpe):
                continue

            candidates.append({
                "symbol": symbol,
                "sector": sectors[symbol],
                "portfolio_sharpe": sharpe,
                "portfolio_size": len(trial_symbols),
            })

        if not candidates:
            raise ValueError(
                f"No valid candidates available at selection step {step}."
            )

        # Deterministic tie-breaking by ticker.
        candidates.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                -item["portfolio_sharpe"],
                item["symbol"],
            )
        )

        winner = candidates[0]

        previous_sharpe = (
            selection_log[-1]["portfolio_sharpe"]
            if selection_log
            else None
        )

        selected.append(winner["symbol"])

        selection_log.append({
            "step": step,
            "symbol": winner["symbol"],
            "sector": winner["sector"],
            "portfolio_size": len(selected),
            "portfolio_sharpe": winner["portfolio_sharpe"],
            "previous_portfolio_sharpe": previous_sharpe,
            "marginal_sharpe_change": (
                winner["portfolio_sharpe"] - previous_sharpe
                if previous_sharpe is not None
                else None
            ),
            "candidates_evaluated": len(candidates),
        })

        print(
            f"Step {step:02d}: {winner['symbol']:<15} "
            f"Sector: {winner['sector']:<25} "
            f"Sharpe: {winner['portfolio_sharpe']:.4f}"
        )

    # Calculate final portfolio metrics.
    final_result = calculate_portfolio(
        prices=prices,
        sectors=sectors,
        symbols=selected,
        risk_free_rate=risk_free_rate,
        max_stocks=target_stocks,
        max_per_sector=max_per_sector,
    )

    print("\nSELECTION COMPLETE")
    print("-" * 65)
    print("Selected stocks:", len(selected))
    print("Unique sectors:", len({
        sectors[symbol] for symbol in selected
    }))
    print("Selected symbols:", ", ".join(selected))
    print("Final Sharpe:", final_result["metrics"].get("sharpe_ratio"))

    return {
        "selected_symbols": selected,
        "selection_log": pd.DataFrame(selection_log),
        "portfolio_result": final_result,
        "assumptions": {
            "selection_method": "SEQUENTIAL_GREEDY_SHARPE",
            "price_basis": "SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            "weighting": "EQUAL_WEIGHT",
            "daily_rebalancing": True,
            "risk_free_rate": risk_free_rate,
            "target_stocks": target_stocks,
            "max_per_sector": max_per_sector,
            "selection_uses_training_data_only": True,
            "globally_optimal": False,
        },
    }

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  Wallet,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

type Holding = {
  symbol: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  invested: number;
  weight: number;
  sector?: string;
};

type PeriodResult = {
  start?: string;
  end?: string;
  observations?: number;
  metrics?: {
    period_return_pct?: number;
    cagr_pct?: number;
    annualized_volatility_pct?: number;
    maximum_drawdown_pct?: number;
    sharpe_ratio?: number;
  };
  benchmark?: {
    portfolio_return_pct?: number;
    benchmark_return_pct?: number;
    excess_return_pct?: number;
  };
};

type PortfolioResult = {
  status: string;
  selection_method: string;
  portfolio: {
    capital: number;
    invested: number;
    cash_remaining: number;
    stock_count: number;
    holdings: Holding[];
  };
  selection_log: {
    step: number;
    symbol: string;
    portfolio_sharpe: number;
    marginal_sharpe_change: number | null;
  }[];
  training: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    observations: number;
    selection_sharpe: number;
  };
  validation: PeriodResult;
  test: PeriodResult;
  data_limitations: {
    historical_membership_survivorship_bias?: boolean;
    dividend_adjusted?: boolean;
    corporate_action_coverage?: string;
    validation_test_missing_prices_filled?: boolean;
  };
  assumptions: {
    selection_method: string;
    daily_rebalancing: boolean;
    selection_uses_training_data_only: boolean;
    globally_optimal: boolean;
  };
};

const money = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number"
    ? value.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
      })
    : "?";

const pct = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number" ? `${value.toFixed(2)}%` : "?";

function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#000000] p-4">
      <p className="text-xs text-[#a3a3a3]">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-white">{value}</p>
      {detail && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#888]">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Performance({
  title,
  period,
}: {
  title: string;
  period: PeriodResult;
}) {
  const m = period.metrics;
  const b = period.benchmark;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#171717] p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-[#999]">
          {period.start ?? "?"} to {period.end ?? "?"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Metric label="Period return" value={pct(m?.period_return_pct)} />
        <Metric label="CAGR" value={pct(m?.cagr_pct)} />
        <Metric label="Sharpe ratio" value={m?.sharpe_ratio?.toFixed(3) ?? "?"} />
        <Metric
          label="Annualized volatility"
          value={pct(m?.annualized_volatility_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Maximum drawdown"
          value={pct(m?.maximum_drawdown_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="NIFTY 50 return"
          value={pct(b?.benchmark_return_pct)}
          detail={`Excess return: ${pct(b?.excess_return_pct)}`}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function PortfolioBuilder({ initialSelectedStock = "" }: { initialSelectedStock?: string }) {
  const [capital, setCapital] = useState("100000");
  const [stockCount, setStockCount] = useState("5");
  const [maxPerSector, setMaxPerSector] = useState("3");
  const [trainingYears, setTrainingYears] = useState("10");
  const [riskFreeRate, setRiskFreeRate] = useState("0");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PortfolioResult | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [addedStocks, setAddedStocks] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = "greedy-stocks-selected";
    let saved: string[] = [];

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        saved = parsed.filter(
          (item): item is string => typeof item === "string"
        ).map((item) => item.toUpperCase());
      }
    } catch {
      saved = [];
    }

    const merged = Array.from(new Set([
      ...saved,
      ...(initialSelectedStock ? [initialSelectedStock.toUpperCase()] : []),
    ]));

    setAddedStocks(merged);
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(merged));
  }, [initialSelectedStock]);

  function removeAddedStock(symbol: string) {
    const updated = addedStocks.filter((item) => item !== symbol);
    setAddedStocks(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("greedy-stocks-selected", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  async function generatePortfolio(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/portfolio/generate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          capital: Number(capital),
          stock_count: Number(stockCount),
          training_years: Number(trainingYears),
          max_per_sector: Number(maxPerSector),
          risk_free_rate: Number(riskFreeRate) / 100,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          typeof data.detail === "string"
            ? data.detail
            : JSON.stringify(data.detail ?? "Portfolio generation failed.")
        );
      }

      setResult(data as PortfolioResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Could not connect to GREEDY STOCKS API."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6 p-5 md:p-8">
      <header>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#aaa]">
          <BriefcaseBusiness size={15} />
          GREEDY V2 PORTFOLIO ENGINE
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
          Portfolio Builder
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-[#aaa]">
          Generate a whole-share portfolio using sequential greedy Sharpe
          selection and evaluate it against NIFTY 50.
        </p>
      </header>

      {addedStocks.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
              Added from Company Explorer
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-cyan-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200">
              {addedStocks.length} {addedStocks.length === 1 ? "stock" : "stocks"} saved
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {addedStocks.map((symbol) => (
              <span key={symbol} className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-cyan-200">
                {symbol}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => removeAddedStock(symbol)}
                  aria-label={`Remove ${symbol}`}
                  className="text-lg leading-none text-cyan-200/70 transition hover:text-red-300"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[#aaa]">
            Your research list is saved in this browser and survives navigation and refreshes.
            Greedy V2 independently selects holdings; these stocks are not forced into the generated portfolio.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
      <form
        onSubmit={generatePortfolio}
        className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5"
      >
        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Investment capital (INR)
          <input
            required
            type="number"
            min="1"
            max="100000000000"
            step="0.01"
            value={capital}
            onChange={(e) => setCapital(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-[#888]"
          />
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Number of stocks
          <select
            value={stockCount}
            onChange={(e) => setStockCount(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} stocks</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Maximum stocks per sector
          <select
            value={maxPerSector}
            onChange={(e) => setMaxPerSector(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Training history
          <select
            value={trainingYears}
            onChange={(e) => setTrainingYears(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          >
            {[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n} years</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="text-sm text-[#bbb]">
          Annual risk-free rate (%)
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            max="100"
            step="0.1"
            value={riskFreeRate}
            onChange={(e) => setRiskFreeRate(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#444] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-white"
          />
        </label>

        <div className="flex items-end md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-5">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-black transition hover:bg-[#ddd] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 md:w-auto"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <RefreshCw size={17} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <TrendingUp size={17} />
            )}
            {loading ? "Generating portfolio..." : "Generate Greedy V2 Portfolio"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-red-950/30 p-4 text-sm text-red-300">
          <AlertTriangle size={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!result && !loading && !error && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#444] p-10 text-center">
          <Wallet size={30} className="mx-auto text-[#888]" />
          <h3 className="mt-3 font-semibold text-white">
            Your portfolio will appear here
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999]">
            Set your investment preferences and generate a portfolio.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <>
          <section className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <Metric label="Starting capital" value={money(result.portfolio.capital)} />
            <Metric label="Amount invested" value={money(result.portfolio.invested)} />
            <Metric label="Cash remaining" value={money(result.portfolio.cash_remaining)} />
            <Metric
              label="Selected stocks"
              value={String(result.portfolio.stock_count)}
              detail="Whole-share allocation"
            />
          </section>

          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]">
            <div className="border-b border-[#303030] p-5">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Your holdings</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999]">
                Latest available raw closing prices; quantities are whole shares.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[650px] text-left text-sm">
                <thead className="bg-[#292929] text-xs text-[#aaa]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Stock</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Sector</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Price</th>

                      <td className="px-5 py-4 text-right">{(holding.weight * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Greedy selection journey</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999]">
              Training period: {result.training.start} to {result.training.end}
              {" ? "}{result.training.observations.toLocaleString("en-IN")} observations
              {" ? "}Selection Sharpe: {result.training.selection_sharpe.toFixed(3)}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              {result.selection_log.map((step) => (
                <div key={step.step} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[#292929] p-3 text-sm">
                  <div>
                    <span className="mr-3 text-[#888]">#{step.step}</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-white">{step.symbol}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right text-[#bbb]">
                    Sharpe {step.portfolio_sharpe.toFixed(3)}
                    {step.marginal_sharpe_change !== null && (
                      <span className={step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "ml-3 text-green-400" : "ml-3 text-red-400"}>
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change.toFixed(3)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
            <Performance title="Validation performance" period={result.validation} />
            <Performance title="Out-of-sample test performance" period={result.test} />
          </div>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#171717] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Methodology and data limitations</h2>
            <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2 text-sm text-[#bbb] md:grid-cols-2">
              <li>? Selection method: {result.assumptions.selection_method}</li>
              <li>? Daily rebalancing: {result.assumptions.daily_rebalancing ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Selection uses training data only: {result.assumptions.selection_uses_training_data_only ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Globally optimal: {result.assumptions.globally_optimal ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Dividend adjusted: {result.data_limitations.dividend_adjusted ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Corporate-action coverage: {result.data_limitations.corporate_action_coverage ?? "Not specified"}</li>
              <li>? Survivorship bias: {result.data_limitations.historical_membership_survivorship_bias ? "Present" : "Not flagged"}</li>
              <li>? Missing evaluation prices filled: {result.data_limitations.validation_test_missing_prices_filled ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-[#303030] pt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#999]">
              Historical validation and test metrics represent a daily-rebalanced,
              equal-weight research portfolio. They are not the realized buy-and-hold
              performance of the whole-share holdings shown above. Historical results
              do not guarantee future returns. For educational research only, not
              investment advice.
            </p>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

"""GREEDY STOCKS ? configurable Greedy V2 portfolio API."""

import logging
import math
import sys
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, FiniteFloat

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from analytics.greedy_v2_data import prepare_greedy_v2_dataset
from analytics.greedy_v2_splits import chronological_split
from analytics.greedy_v2_engine import greedy_select_stocks
from analytics.portfolio_analytics import (
    calculate_portfolio,
    compare_with_benchmark,
)
from analytics.portfolio_allocation import allocate_capital

router = APIRouter(tags=["Portfolio"])
logger = logging.getLogger("greedy_stocks_portfolio")


class PortfolioRequest(BaseModel):
    capital: FiniteFloat = Field(gt=0, le=100_000_000_000)
    stock_count: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10)
    training_years: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=10)
    max_per_sector: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    risk_free_rate: FiniteFloat = Field(default=0.0, ge=0, le=1)


def _clean(value):
    if hasattr(value, "item"):
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, (date,)):
        return value.isoformat()
    if hasattr(value, "isoformat") and not isinstance(value, str):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None
    return value


def _metrics(result):
    return {
        str(key): _clean(value)
        for key, value in result["metrics"].items()
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool))
        or value is None
    }


@router.post("/portfolio/generate")
def generate_portfolio(request: PortfolioRequest):
    """Generate a capital-constrained portfolio using original Greedy V2."""
    try:
        today = date.today()
        end_date = today.isoformat()
        start_date = (today - timedelta(days=365 * request.training_years)).isoformat()

        dataset = prepare_greedy_v2_dataset(
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
        )

        split = chronological_split(
            dataset.adjusted_prices,
            allow_sparse_evaluation=True,
        )

        # Greedy selection sees training data only.
        selection = greedy_select_stocks(
            train_prices=split.train,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            target_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
        )

        symbols = selection["selected_symbols"]

        # Latest raw close is used for executable share quantities.
        latest_prices = {}

        for symbol in symbols:
            raw_column = (
                symbol if symbol in dataset.raw_prices.columns
                else f"{symbol}_RAW"
            )

            if raw_column not in dataset.raw_prices.columns:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Raw price history unavailable for {symbol} "
                    f"(expected column: {raw_column})."
                )

            available = dataset.raw_prices[raw_column].dropna()

            if available.empty:
                raise ValueError(f"No usable raw price is available for {symbol}.")

            latest_prices[symbol] = float(available.iloc[-1])

        allocation = allocate_capital(
            symbols=symbols,
            prices=latest_prices,
            capital=float(request.capital),
        )

        # Validation-period metrics are kept separate from training selection.
        validation_prices = split.validation
        validation_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(split.validation.index)

        validation_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=validation_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_prices = split.test
        test_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(test_prices.index)

        test_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=test_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            test_result["daily_returns"],
            test_benchmark,
        )

        comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            validation_result["daily_returns"],
            validation_benchmark,
        )

        holdings = allocation["holdings"]
        for holding in holdings:
            holding["sector"] = dataset.sectors[holding["symbol"]]

        return {
            "status": "success",
            "selection_method": "SEQUENTIAL_GREEDY_SHARPE",
            "portfolio": allocation,
            "holdings": holdings,
            "selection_log": selection["selection_log"].to_dict(
                orient="records"
            ),
            "training": {
                "start": str(split.train.index.min().date()),
                "end": str(split.train.index.max().date()),
                "observations": len(split.train),
                "selection_sharpe": _clean(
                    selection["portfolio_result"]["metrics"].get("sharpe_ratio")
                ),
            },
            "validation": {
                "start": str(validation_prices.index.min().date()),
                "end": str(validation_prices.index.max().date()),
                "observations": len(validation_prices),
                "metrics": _metrics(validation_result),
                "benchmark": {
                    key: _clean(value)
                    for key, value in comparison.items()
                    if key != "comparison_returns"
                },
            },
            "test": {
                "start": str(test_prices.index[1].date()),
                "end": str(test_prices.index[-1].date()),
                "observations": len(test_prices) - 1,
                "metrics": _metrics(test_result),
                "benchmark": {
                    key: _clean(value)
                    for key, value in test_comparison.items()
                    if key != "comparison_returns"
                },
            },
            "data_limitations": {
                "membership_basis": dataset.metadata["membership_basis"],
                "corporate_action_coverage": dataset.metadata[
                    "corporate_action_coverage"
                ],
                "dividend_adjusted": dataset.metadata["dividend_adjusted"],
                "price_basis": dataset.metadata["price_basis"],
                "benchmark_basis": "NIFTY_50_PRICE_RETURN",
                "historical_membership_survivorship_bias": True,
                "historical_metrics_are_daily_rebalanced": True,
                "live_holdings_use_latest_raw_close": True,
            },
            "assumptions": selection["assumptions"],
        }

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Portfolio generation failed.")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Portfolio generation failed. Check backend logs.",
        ) from exc
"""GREEDY STOCKS - Configurable Greedy V2 portfolio API."""

import logging
import math
import sys
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, FiniteFloat

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from analytics.greedy_v2_data import prepare_greedy_v2_dataset
from analytics.greedy_v2_splits import chronological_split
from analytics.greedy_v2_engine import greedy_select_stocks
from analytics.portfolio_analytics import (
    calculate_portfolio,
    compare_with_benchmark,
)
from analytics.portfolio_allocation import allocate_capital

router = APIRouter(tags=["Portfolio"])
logger = logging.getLogger("greedy_stocks_portfolio")


class PortfolioRequest(BaseModel):
    capital: FiniteFloat = Field(gt=0, le=100_000_000_000)
    stock_count: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10)
    training_years: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=10)
    max_per_sector: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    risk_free_rate: FiniteFloat = Field(default=0.0, ge=0, le=1)


def _clean(value):
    """Convert NumPy/Pandas values into JSON-safe Python values."""
    if value is None:
        return None

    if value is pd.NaT or value is pd.NA:
        return None

    if isinstance(value, (pd.Timestamp, date)):
        return value.isoformat()

    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        value = value.item()

    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _clean(v) for k, v in value.items()}

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_clean(v) for v in value]

    return value


def _metrics(result):
    return _clean(result.get("metrics", {}))


def _period_summary(prices, include_baseline=True):
    if prices is None or prices.empty:
        raise ValueError("Insufficient historical observations for this period.")

    start_index = 0 if include_baseline else 1

    if len(prices) <= start_index:
        raise ValueError("Insufficient historical observations for this period.")

    measured = prices.iloc[start_index:]

    return {
        "start": str(measured.index.min().date()),
        "end": str(measured.index.max().date()),
        "observations": len(measured),
    }


def _benchmark_summary(comparison):
    return {
        str(key): _clean(value)
        for key, value in comparison.items()
        if key != "comparison_returns"
    }


@router.post("/portfolio/generate")
def generate_portfolio(request: PortfolioRequest):
    """Generate a capital-constrained portfolio using original Greedy V2."""

    try:
        today = date.today()
        end_date = today.isoformat()
        start_date = (
            today - timedelta(days=365 * request.training_years)
        ).isoformat()

        dataset = prepare_greedy_v2_dataset(
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
        )

        if dataset.adjusted_prices is None or dataset.adjusted_prices.empty:
            raise ValueError("No adjusted historical stock prices are available.")

        if dataset.benchmark_prices is None or dataset.benchmark_prices.empty:
            raise ValueError("Historical NIFTY 50 benchmark prices are unavailable.")

        # Chronological split: selection uses training data only.
        split = chronological_split(dataset.adjusted_prices, allow_sparse_evaluation=True)

        if split.train.empty or split.validation.empty or split.test.empty:
            raise ValueError(
                "Insufficient historical data to create train, validation and test periods."
            )

        # Preserve the original sequential Greedy V2 selection algorithm.
        selection = greedy_select_stocks(
            train_prices=split.train,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            target_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
        )

        symbols = selection["selected_symbols"]

        if not symbols:
            raise ValueError("Greedy V2 did not select any stocks.")

        # Latest available raw close is used for executable share quantities.
        latest_prices = {}

        for symbol in symbols:
            raw_column = (
                symbol if symbol in dataset.raw_prices.columns
                else f"{symbol}_RAW"
            )
            if raw_column not in dataset.raw_prices.columns:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Raw price history is unavailable for {symbol}."
                )

            available = dataset.raw_prices[raw_column].dropna()

            if available.empty:
                raise ValueError(f"No usable raw price is available for {symbol}.")

            latest_prices[symbol] = float(available.iloc[-1])

        allocation = allocate_capital(
            symbols=symbols,
            prices=latest_prices,
            capital=float(request.capital),
        )

        holdings = allocation["holdings"]

        for holding in holdings:
            symbol = holding["symbol"]
            holding["sector"] = dataset.sectors.get(symbol, "Unknown")

        # Validation period: evaluate selected symbols without re-selection.
        validation_prices = split.validation
        validation_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(
            validation_prices.index
        )

        validation_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=validation_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        validation_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            validation_result["daily_returns"],
            validation_benchmark,
        )

        # Final test period remains separate from training and validation.
        test_prices = split.test
        test_benchmark = dataset.benchmark_prices.reindex(test_prices.index)

        test_result = calculate_portfolio(
            prices=test_prices,
            sectors=dataset.sectors,
            symbols=symbols,
            risk_free_rate=request.risk_free_rate,
            max_stocks=request.stock_count,
            max_per_sector=request.max_per_sector,
            price_basis="SPLIT_BONUS_ADJUSTED",
            return_type="PRICE_RETURN",
        )

        test_comparison = compare_with_benchmark(
            test_result["daily_returns"],
            test_benchmark,
        )

        training_period = _period_summary(split.train)
        validation_period = _period_summary(validation_prices, include_baseline=False)
        test_period = _period_summary(test_prices, include_baseline=False)

        return _clean({
            "status": "success",
            "selection_method": "SEQUENTIAL_GREEDY_SHARPE",
            "portfolio": allocation,
            "holdings": holdings,
            "selection_log": selection["selection_log"].to_dict(
                orient="records"
            ),
            "training": {
                **training_period,
                "selection_sharpe": selection["portfolio_result"][
                    "metrics"
                ].get("sharpe_ratio"),
            },
            "validation": {
                **validation_period,
                "metrics": _metrics(validation_result),
                "benchmark": _benchmark_summary(validation_comparison),
            },
            "test": {
                **test_period,
                "metrics": _metrics(test_result),
                "benchmark": _benchmark_summary(test_comparison),
            },
            "data_limitations": {
                "membership_basis": dataset.metadata["membership_basis"],
                "corporate_action_coverage": dataset.metadata[
                    "corporate_action_coverage"
                ],
                "dividend_adjusted": dataset.metadata["dividend_adjusted"],
                "price_basis": dataset.metadata["price_basis"],
                "benchmark_basis": "NIFTY_50_PRICE_RETURN",
                "historical_membership_survivorship_bias": True,
                "historical_metrics_are_daily_rebalanced": True,
                "live_holdings_use_latest_raw_close": True,
                "actual_holdings_buy_and_hold_metrics_calculated": False,
                "training_candidate_count": len(split.metadata["eligible_training_symbols"]),
                "excluded_incomplete_training_symbols": split.metadata[
                    "excluded_incomplete_training_symbols"
                ],
                "validation_test_missing_prices_filled": False,
            },
            "assumptions": selection["assumptions"],
        })

    except ValueError as exc:
        logger.warning("Portfolio request rejected: %s", exc)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Portfolio generation failed.")
        # Diagnostic detail is temporary. Replace with a generic message
        # before deploying this endpoint publicly.
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
        ) from exc
