function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ul>
          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="pl-1 leading-7">
              {children}
            </li>
          ),

          hr: () => (
            <hr className="my-6 border-[#505050]" />
          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">
              {children}
            </blockquote>
          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {
            const isBlock = Boolean(className);

            return isBlock ? (
              <code className="block overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#dddddd]">
                {children}
              </code>
            ) : (
              <code className="rounded bg-[#414141] px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-[#eeeeee]">
                {children}
              </code>
            );
          },

          pre: ({ children }) => (
            <pre className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] p-4">
              {children}
            </pre>
          ),

          a: ({ children, href }) => (
            <a
              href={href}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#b8cfff] underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-white"
            >
              {children}
            </a>
          ),

          table: ({ children }) => (
            <div className="my-5 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141]">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left text-xs">
                {children}
              </table>
            </div>
          ),

          th: ({ children }) => (
            <th className="border-b border-[#505050] bg-[#303030] px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white">
              {children}
            </th>
          ),

          td: ({ children }) => (
            <td className="border-b border-[#414141] px-4 py-3">
              {children}
            </td>
          ),
        }}
      >
        {content}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="greedy-welcome flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">

              <div className="mb-7 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#212121] text-[#b4b4b4]">
                <MessageSquare size={26} />
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.035em] text-[#ececec] md:text-[32px]">
                Ready when you are.
              </h1>
<p className="greedy-welcome-tagline">
  Understand the market. <span>Question the numbers.</span> Build your conviction.
</p>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-[13px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#999999]">
                Ask about NIFTY 50 companies, stock market concepts,
                historical performance, financial metrics and risk.
                GREEDY is here to make things simple.
              </p>

              <div className="greedy-welcome-suggestions hidden">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
{/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="greedy-composer greedy-welcome-composer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-[#353535] bg-[#1c1c1c] px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_5px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] transition-all duration-200 focus-within:border-[#555555]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={1}
                placeholder="Message GREEDY..."
                disabled={loading}
                className="greedy-composer-input max-h-40 min-h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent px-1 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                aria-label="Send message"
                className="greedy-send-button flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
              >
                <ArrowUp size={19} />
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS &middot; Educational research only &middot; Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT
// --------------------------------------------------

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">

      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {

              const active = currentNav === item.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.name}

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] p-8 text-[#eeeeee]">
          Loading GREEDY STOCKS...
        </main>
      }
    >
      <HomeContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// REUSABLE MARKET CARD
// --------------------------------------------------

function MarketCard({
  label,
  value,
  change,
  positive,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  positive: boolean;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 transition hover:border-[#555555]">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-[#999999]">
          {label}
        </p>

        <span className="text-[#aaaaaa]">{icon}</span>
      </div>

      <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
        {value}
      </p>

      <p
        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
          positive ? "text-[#75b798]" : "text-[#d5b477]"
        }`}
      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// CHAT TYPES

type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ul>
          ),

          ol: ({ children }) => (
            <ol className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">
              {children}
            </ol>
          ),

          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="pl-1 leading-7">
              {children}
            </li>
          ),

          hr: () => (
            <hr className="my-6 border-[#505050]" />
          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">
              {children}
            </blockquote>
          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {
            const isBlock = Boolean(className);

            return isBlock ? (
              <code className="block overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#dddddd]">
                {children}
              </code>
            ) : (
              <code className="rounded bg-[#414141] px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-[#eeeeee]">
                {children}
              </code>
            );
          },

          pre: ({ children }) => (
            <pre className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] p-4">
              {children}
            </pre>
          ),

          a: ({ children, href }) => (
            <a
              href={href}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#b8cfff] underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-white"
            >
              {children}
            </a>
          ),

          table: ({ children }) => (
            <div className="my-5 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#414141]">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left text-xs">
                {children}
              </table>
            </div>
          ),

          th: ({ children }) => (
            <th className="border-b border-[#505050] bg-[#353535] px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white">
              {children}
            </th>
          ),

          td: ({ children }) => (
            <td className="border-b border-[#414141] px-4 py-3">
              {children}
            </td>
          ),
        }}
      >
        {content}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

// ASK GREEDY CHAT

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#212121]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-10">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">

              <div className="mb-6 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[#303030] text-[#e5e5e5]">
                <MessageSquare size={26} />
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#ececec] md:text-4xl">
                What would you like to understand?
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-4 max-w-md text-sm leading-7 text-[#a0a0a0]">
                Ask about NIFTY 50 companies, stock market concepts,
                historical performance, financial metrics and risk.
                GREEDY is here to make things simple.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-9 grid w-full gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#2a2a2a] p-4 text-left text-xs leading-5 text-[#d4d4d4] transition hover:border-[#666666] hover:bg-[#353535]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 md:max-w-[90%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-br-md bg-[#303030] text-sm leading-7 text-[#ececec]"
                        : "rounded-bl-md bg-[#292929] text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#292929] px-5 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#212121] pb-6 pt-5">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="rounded-3xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#303030] p-3 shadow-2xl transition focus-within:border-[#666666]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={2}
                placeholder="Message GREEDY..."
                disabled={loading}
                className="max-h-40 min-h-12 w-full resize-y bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-6 text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#a0a0a0] disabled:opacity-60"
              />

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pt-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#a0a0a0]">
                  Ask anything about the Indian stock market
                </p>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                  aria-label="Send message"
                  className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  <ArrowUp size={19} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
              GREEDY STOCKS Â· Educational research only Â· Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#212121] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#303030] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const active = currentNav === item.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.name}
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation(item.name)}
                  title={sidebarCollapsed ? item.name : undefined}
                  aria-label={item.name}
                  className={`
                    flex items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-left
                    text-sm transition
                    ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"}
                    ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-[#303030] font-semibold text-[#ffffff]"
                        : "text-[#a0a0a0] hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-[#eeeeee]"
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <Icon size={19} className="shrink-0" />

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

          <div className={`mt-7 flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777]">
                Your chats
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={startNewChat}
                title="Start a new chat"
                aria-label="Start a new chat"
                className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-[#aaaaaa] transition hover:bg-[#303030] hover:text-white"
              >
                <MessageSquare size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={startNewChat}
              className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#414141] px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-[#dddddd] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-white"
            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none">+</span>
              New Chat
            </button>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {historyLoading && conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#888888]">Loading chats...</p>
              ) : historyError ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-300">{historyError}</p>
              ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[#777777]">
                  Your saved conversations will appear here.
                </p>
              ) : (
                conversations.map((conversation) => {
                  const selected = parsedConversationId === conversation.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={conversation.id}

function MarketCard({
  label,
  value,
  change,
  positive,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  positive: boolean;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#383838] bg-[#262626] p-5 transition hover:border-[#555555]">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-[#999999]">
          {label}
        </p>

        <span className="text-[#aaaaaa]">{icon}</span>
      </div>

      <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
        {value}
      </p>

      <p
        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
          positive ? "text-[#75b798]" : "text-[#d5b477]"
        }`}
      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  RefreshCw,

  Wallet,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

type Holding = {
  symbol: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  invested: number;
  weight: number;
  sector?: string;
};

type PeriodResult = {
  start?: string;
  end?: string;
  observations?: number;
  metrics?: {
    period_return_pct?: number;
    cagr_pct?: number;
    annualized_volatility_pct?: number;
    maximum_drawdown_pct?: number;
    sharpe_ratio?: number;
  };
  benchmark?: {
    portfolio_return_pct?: number;
    benchmark_return_pct?: number;
    excess_return_pct?: number;
  };
};

type PortfolioResult = {
  status: string;
  selection_method: string;
  portfolio: {
    capital: number;
    invested: number;
    cash_remaining: number;
    stock_count: number;
    holdings: Holding[];
  };
  selection_log: {
    step: number;
    symbol: string;
    portfolio_sharpe: number;
    marginal_sharpe_change: number | null;
  }[];
  training: {
    start: string;
    end: string;
    observations: number;
    selection_sharpe: number;
  };
  validation: PeriodResult;
  test: PeriodResult;
  data_limitations: {
    historical_membership_survivorship_bias?: boolean;
    dividend_adjusted?: boolean;
    corporate_action_coverage?: string;
    validation_test_missing_prices_filled?: boolean;
  };
  assumptions: {
    selection_method: string;
    daily_rebalancing: boolean;
    selection_uses_training_data_only: boolean;
    globally_optimal: boolean;
  };
};

const money = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number"
    ? value.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        style: "currency",
        currency: "INR",
        maximumFractionDigits: 2,
      })
    : "?";

const pct = (value?: number) =>
  typeof value === "number" ? `${value.toFixed(2)}%` : "?";

function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  detail?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#252525] p-4">
      <p className="text-xs text-[#a3a3a3]">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-white">{value}</p>
      {detail && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#888]">{detail}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Performance({
  title,
  period,
}: {
  title: string;
  period: PeriodResult;
}) {
  const m = period.metrics;
  const b = period.benchmark;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#343434] bg-[#202020] p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-[#999]">
          {period.start ?? "?"} to {period.end ?? "?"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Metric label="Period return" value={pct(m?.period_return_pct)} />
        <Metric label="CAGR" value={pct(m?.cagr_pct)} />
        <Metric label="Sharpe ratio" value={m?.sharpe_ratio?.toFixed(3) ?? "?"} />
        <Metric
          label="Annualized volatility"
          value={pct(m?.annualized_volatility_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Maximum drawdown"
          value={pct(m?.maximum_drawdown_pct)}
        />
        <Metric
          label="NIFTY 50 return"
          value={pct(b?.benchmark_return_pct)}
          detail={`Excess return: ${pct(b?.excess_return_pct)}`}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function PortfolioBuilder({ initialSelectedStock = "" }: { initialSelectedStock?: string }) {
  const [capital, setCapital] = useState("100000");
  const [stockCount, setStockCount] = useState("5");
  const [maxPerSector, setMaxPerSector] = useState("3");
  const [trainingYears, setTrainingYears] = useState("10");
  const [riskFreeRate, setRiskFreeRate] = useState("0");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PortfolioResult | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [addedStocks, setAddedStocks] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = "greedy-stocks-selected";
    let saved: string[] = [];

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        saved = parsed.filter(
          (item): item is string => typeof item === "string"
        ).map((item) => item.toUpperCase());
      }
    } catch {
      saved = [];
    }

    const merged = Array.from(new Set([
      ...saved,
      ...(initialSelectedStock ? [initialSelectedStock.toUpperCase()] : []),
    ]));

    setAddedStocks(merged);
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(merged));
  }, [initialSelectedStock]);

  function removeAddedStock(symbol: string) {
    const updated = addedStocks.filter((item) => item !== symbol);
    setAddedStocks(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("greedy-stocks-selected", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  async function generatePortfolio(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/portfolio/generate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          capital: Number(capital),
          stock_count: Number(stockCount),
          training_years: Number(trainingYears),
          max_per_sector: Number(maxPerSector),
          risk_free_rate: Number(riskFreeRate) / 100,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          typeof data.detail === "string"
            ? data.detail
            : JSON.stringify(data.detail ?? "Portfolio generation failed.")
        );
      }

      setResult(data as PortfolioResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Could not connect to GREEDY STOCKS API."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-6 p-5 md:p-8">
      <header>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#aaa]">
          <BriefcaseBusiness size={15} />
          GREEDY V2 PORTFOLIO ENGINE
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
          Portfolio Builder
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-[#aaa]">
          Generate a whole-share portfolio using sequential greedy Sharpe
          selection and evaluate it against NIFTY 50.
        </p>
      </header>

      {addedStocks.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
              Added from Company Explorer
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-cyan-400/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200">
              {addedStocks.length} {addedStocks.length === 1 ? "stock" : "stocks"} saved
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {addedStocks.map((symbol) => (
              <span key={symbol} className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-cyan-200">
                {symbol}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => removeAddedStock(symbol)}
                  aria-label={`Remove ${symbol}`}
                  className="text-lg leading-none text-cyan-200/70 transition hover:text-red-300"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[#aaa]">
            Your research list is saved in this browser and survives navigation and refreshes.
            Greedy V2 independently selects holdings; these stocks are not forced into the generated portfolio.
          </p>
        </section>
      )}
      <form
        onSubmit={generatePortfolio}
        className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#383838] bg-[#202020] p-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5"

              {" ? "}{result.training.observations.toLocaleString("en-IN")} observations

            </p>

                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                        {step.marginal_sharpe_change.toFixed(3)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
            <Performance title="Validation performance" period={result.validation} />
            <Performance title="Out-of-sample test performance" period={result.test} />
          </div>

          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#383838] bg-[#202020] p-5">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Methodology and data limitations</h2>
            <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2 text-sm text-[#bbb] md:grid-cols-2">
              <li>? Selection method: {result.assumptions.selection_method}</li>
              <li>? Daily rebalancing: {result.assumptions.daily_rebalancing ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Selection uses training data only: {result.assumptions.selection_uses_training_data_only ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Globally optimal: {result.assumptions.globally_optimal ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Dividend adjusted: {result.data_limitations.dividend_adjusted ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
              <li>? Corporate-action coverage: {result.data_limitations.corporate_action_coverage ?? "Not specified"}</li>
              <li>? Survivorship bias: {result.data_limitations.historical_membership_survivorship_bias ? "Present" : "Not flagged"}</li>
              <li>? Missing evaluation prices filled: {result.data_limitations.validation_test_missing_prices_filled ? "Yes" : "No"}</li>
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-[#383838] pt-4 text-xs leading-6 text-[#999]">
              Historical validation and test metrics represent a daily-rebalanced,
              equal-weight research portfolio. They are not the realized buy-and-hold
              performance of the whole-share holdings shown above. Historical results
              do not guarantee future returns. For educational research only, not
              investment advice.
            </p>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">

              <div className="mb-7 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#212121] text-[#b4b4b4]">
                <MessageSquare size={26} />
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.035em] text-[#ececec] md:text-[32px]">
                What would you like to understand?
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-[13px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#999999]">
                Ask about NIFTY 50 companies, stock market concepts,
                historical performance, financial metrics and risk.
                GREEDY is here to make things simple.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-7 grid w-full gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="rounded-[26px] border border-[#424242] bg-[#212121] p-3 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.18)] transition duration-200 focus-within:border-[#666666]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={2}
                placeholder="Message GREEDY..."
                disabled={loading}
                className="max-h-40 min-h-10 w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pt-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#a0a0a0]">
                  Ask anything about the Indian stock market
                </p>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                  aria-label="Send message"
                  className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  <ArrowUp size={19} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS Â· Educational research only Â· Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT
// --------------------------------------------------

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${

            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {

              return (

                  key={item.name}
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation(item.name)}

                    flex items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left

                    ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"}
                    ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-[#222222] font-medium text-[#ffffff]"
                        : "text-[#a0a0a0] hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-[#eeeeee]"
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <Icon size={19} className="shrink-0" />

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none">+</span>

            </button>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">

              ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (

                    Your personal Indian stock market learning space

          )}

          {/* ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav === "Ask GREEDY" ? (

              initialConversationId={parsedConversationId}
              onConversationUpdated={() => void refreshConversations()}
            />
          ) : currentNav === "Explore & Discover" ? (
            <ExploreDiscover />

          ) : (

                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#b0b0b0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    YOUR MARKET LEARNING DASHBOARD

                >
                  <MessageSquare size={16} />
                  Ask GREEDY
                </button>

              {/* DATA NOTICE */}

              <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#555044] bg-[#302d25] p-3.5">

                  <strong className="text-[#f0d99e]">
                    Prototype preview:
                  </strong>{" "}
                  All market values and chart points on this screen are illustrative
                  sample data, not live market prices or investment recommendations.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* MARKET CARDS */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">

                  value="22,680.40"
                  change="+1.24%"
                  positive
                  icon={<TrendingUp size={18} />}

                  <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">

                      </p>

                      </p>

                      {periods.map((period) => (
                        <button
                          key={period}
                          onClick={() => setActivePeriod(period)}
                          className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition ${
                            activePeriod === period
                              ? "bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717]"
                              : "text-[#999999] hover:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >

                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mb-4">
                    <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">

                              offset="95%"

                            />
                          </linearGradient>
                        </defs>

                        />

                        <XAxis
                          dataKey="day"

                        />

                        />

                  <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
                    Sample chart Â· Period selector is a UI preview; data is not

                  </p>

                {/* GREEDY GUIDE */}

type ChatMessage = {
  id: number;
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
};

type ChatApiResponse = {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_message: string;
  assistant_message: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ConversationHistoryResponse = {
  conversation: {
    id: number;
    title: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
  };
  messages: Array<{
    id: number;
    role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "tool";
    content: string;
    created_at: string;
  }>;
};

type ConversationListItem = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  last_message: string | null;
  message_count: number;
};

type ConversationListResponse = {
  conversations: ConversationListItem[];
};

const API_BASE_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

function AssistantMarkdown({ content }: { content: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="greedy-markdown min-w-0 text-sm leading-7 text-[#e5e5e5]">
      <ReactMarkdown
        remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
        components={{
          h1: ({ children }) => (
            <h1 className="mb-4 mt-7 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h1>
          ),

          h2: ({ children }) => (
            <h2 className="mb-3 mt-7 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h2>
          ),

          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="mb-2 mt-6 text-base font-bold text-white first:mt-0">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),

          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="mb-2 mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),

          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-4 leading-7 last:mb-0">
              {children}
            </p>
          ),

          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-bold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),

          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-[#dddddd]">
              {children}
            </em>
          ),

          ul: ({ children }) => (
            <ul className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 marker:text-[#aaaaaa]">

          ol: ({ children }) => (

          li: ({ children }) => (

          ),

          blockquote: ({ children }) => (
            <blockquote className="my-5 border-l-2 border-[#888888] pl-4 text-[#bdbdbd]">

          ),

          code: ({ children, className }) => {

            return isBlock ? (
