// --------------------------------------------------
// ASK GREEDY CHAT
// --------------------------------------------------

function AskGreedyChat({
  initialQuestion,
  initialConversationId,
  onConversationUpdated,
}: {
  initialQuestion: string;
  initialConversationId: number | null;
  onConversationUpdated: () => void;
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initialQuestion);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<number | null>(
    initialConversationId
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(initialQuestion);
  }, [initialQuestion]);

  // Restore saved messages whenever a conversation ID is present in the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialConversationId) {
      setConversationId(null);
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();

    async function restoreConversation() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${initialConversationId}`,
          {
            method: "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            data.detail || "GREEDY could not restore this conversation."
          );
        }

        const result = data as ConversationHistoryResponse;

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setConversationId(result.conversation.id);
        setMessages(
          result.messages
            .filter(
              (message) =>
                message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant"
            )
            .map((message) => ({
              id: message.id,
              role: message.role as "user" | "assistant",
              content: message.content,
            }))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") return;

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err.message
              : "Conversation restoration failed."
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    void restoreConversation();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [initialConversationId]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const question = draft.trim();

    if (!question || loading) return;

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now(),
      role: "user",
      content: question,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [...previous, userMessage]);
    setDraft("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: question,
          conversation_id: conversationId,
        }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          data.detail || "GREEDY could not process your message."
        );
      }

      const result = data as ChatApiResponse;

      setConversationId(result.conversation_id);

      // Keep the conversation addressable after refresh or when the URL is shared.
      const conversationUrl = `/?conversation=${result.conversation_id}`;
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", conversationUrl);

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          id: Date.now() + 1,
          role: "assistant",
          content: result.assistant_message,
        },
      ]);
      onConversationUpdated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Something went wrong. Please try again."
      );

      setDraft(question);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-[#000000] font-sans tracking-[-0.01em]">
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col">

          {/* EMPTY CHAT STATE */}

          {messages.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">

              <div className="mb-7 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#212121] text-[#b4b4b4]">
                <MessageSquare size={26} />
              </div>

              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.035em] text-[#ececec] md:text-[32px]">
                What would you like to understand?
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-[13px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#999999]">
                Ask about NIFTY 50 companies, stock market concepts,
                historical performance, financial metrics and risk.
                GREEDY is here to make things simple.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-7 grid w-full gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {[
                  "Explain NIFTY 50 in simple words",
                  "How do I understand stock returns?",
                  "What is the difference between risk and volatility?",
                  "How should I analyse a company?",
                ].map((question) => (
                  <button
                    key={question}
                    onClick={() => setDraft(question)}
                    className="min-h-[58px] rounded-2xl border border-[#292929] bg-[#0b0b0b] px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] leading-5 text-[#a8a8a8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#414141] hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#ededed]"
                  >
                    {question}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (

            /* CHAT MESSAGES */

            <div className="flex-1 space-y-7 py-8">
              {messages.map((message) => (
                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`flex ${
                    message.role === "user"
                      ? "justify-end"
                      : "justify-start"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`min-w-0 max-w-[95%] px-1 py-3 md:max-w-[82%] ${
                      message.role === "user"
                        ? "whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-[22px] rounded-br-md bg-[#252525] px-5 py-3 text-[14px] leading-7 text-[#ededed]"
                        : "bg-transparent text-[#e5e5e5]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {message.role === "assistant" ? (
                      <AssistantMarkdown content={message.content} />
                    ) : (
                      message.content
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    GREEDY is thinking...
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {error && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-900 bg-[#351f1f] p-4 text-sm text-red-200">
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MESSAGE COMPOSER */}

          <div className="sticky bottom-0 mt-auto bg-[#000000] pb-5 pt-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
              className="greedy-composer flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-[#353535] bg-[#1c1c1c] px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_5px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.16)] transition-all duration-200 focus-within:border-[#555555]"
            >
              <textarea
                value={draft}
                onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    if (draft.trim() && !loading) {
                      event.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit();
                    }
                  }
                }}
                rows={1}
                placeholder="Message GREEDY..."
                disabled={loading}
                className="greedy-composer-input max-h-40 min-h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent px-1 py-2 text-[14px] leading-6 tracking-[-0.01em] text-[#ececec] outline-none placeholder:text-[#858585] disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || loading}
                aria-label="Send message"
                className="greedy-send-button flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#ececec] text-[#171717] transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
              >
                <ArrowUp size={19} />
              </button>
            </form>

            <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-[#777777]">
              GREEDY STOCKS &middot; Educational research only &middot; Not investment advice
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// MAIN APPLICATION CONTENT

function HomeContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const questionFromUrl = searchParams.get("question") || "";
  const conversationParam = searchParams.get("conversation") || "";
  const stockFromUrl = (searchParams.get("addStock") || "").toUpperCase().trim();

  const parsedConversationId =
    /^\d+$/.test(conversationParam) &&
    Number.isSafeInteger(Number(conversationParam)) &&
    Number(conversationParam) > 0
      ? Number(conversationParam)
      : null;

  const [activeNav, setActiveNav] = useState(
    "Ask GREEDY"
  );

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState("1W");
  const [mobileMenu, setMobileMenu] = useState(false);
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationListItem[]>([]);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState("");

  const refreshConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setHistoryError("");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations`, {
        method: "GET",
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not load chat history.");
      }

      setConversations(
        ((data as ConversationListResponse).conversations || []).filter(
          (conversation) => Number.isSafeInteger(conversation.id)
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setHistoryError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load chat history."
      );
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshConversations();
  }, [refreshConversations]);

  function startNewChat() {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push("/");
  }

  function openConversation(id: number) {
    setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
    setMobileMenu(false);
    router.push(`/?conversation=${id}`);
  }

  async function removeConversation(id: number) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      "Delete this conversation permanently?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE_URL}/chat/conversations/${id}`,
        { method: "DELETE" }
      );
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.detail || "Could not delete conversation.");
      }

      setConversations((previous) =>
        previous.filter((conversation) => conversation.id !== id)
      );

      if (parsedConversationId === id) {
        setActiveNav("Ask GREEDY");
        router.replace("/");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not delete conversation."
      );
    }
  }

  const currentNav =
    questionFromUrl || parsedConversationId
      ? "Ask GREEDY"
      : stockFromUrl
        ? "Portfolio Builder"
        : activeNav;

  function handleNavigation(name: string) {
    setActiveNav(name);
    setMobileMenu(false);

    if (
      name !== "Ask GREEDY" &&
      (questionFromUrl || conversationParam || stockFromUrl)
    ) {
      router.replace("/");
    }
  }

  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    setMobileMenu((value) => !value);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-[#ececec]">
      <div className="flex min-h-screen">

        {/* MOBILE BACKDROP */}

        {mobileMenu && (
          <button
            aria-label="Close navigation"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenu(false)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/60 lg:hidden"
          />
        )}

        {/* SIDEBAR */}

        <aside
          className={`
            fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col
            border-r border-[#303030] bg-[#171717]
            p-4 transition-all duration-200
            lg:static lg:translate-x-0
            ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:w-[76px]" : "lg:w-64"}
            ${
              mobileMenu
                ? "w-64 translate-x-0"
                : "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0"
            }
          `}
        >

          {/* BRAND WITH HOVER SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

<div
  className={`group relative mb-10 flex h-10 items-center ${
    sidebarCollapsed ? "justify-center" : "gap-3"
  }`}
>
  {/* LOGO ICON */}

  <div className="relative flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-0">
      <TrendingUp size={23} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </div>

    {/* TOGGLE APPEARS ON HOVER */}

    <button
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed((value) => !value)}
      aria-label={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"}
      className="absolute inset-0 hidden items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#aaaaaa] transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white group-hover:opacity-100 lg:flex"
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={21} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={21} />
      )}
    </button>
  </div>

  {/* BRAND TEXT */}

  {!sidebarCollapsed && (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-[#eeeeee]">
        GREEDY<span className="text-[#a0a0a0]">.</span>
      </h1>

      <p className="text-[10px] tracking-[0.25em] text-[#888888]">
        STOCKS
      </p>
    </div>
  )}
</div>

          {/* WORKSPACE LABEL */}

          <p
            className={`mb-3 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777] ${
              sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
            }`}
          >
            Workspace
          </p>

          {/* NAVIGATION */}

          <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {navigation.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const active = currentNav === item.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={item.name}
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation(item.name)}
                  title={sidebarCollapsed ? item.name : undefined}
                  aria-label={item.name}
                  className={`
                    flex items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left
                    text-sm transition
                    ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"}
                    ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-[#222222] font-medium text-[#ffffff]"
                        : "text-[#a0a0a0] hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-[#eeeeee]"
                    }
                  `}
                >
                  <Icon size={19} className="shrink-0" />

                  <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* SAVED CONVERSATION HISTORY */}

          <div className={`mt-7 flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col ${sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between px-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#777777]">
                Your chats
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={startNewChat}
                title="Start a new chat"
                aria-label="Start a new chat"
                className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-[#aaaaaa] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
              >
                <MessageSquare size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={startNewChat}
              className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#303030] px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] font-medium text-[#c8c8c8] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#454545] hover:bg-[#202020] hover:text-white"
            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none">+</span>
              New Chat
            </button>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {historyLoading && conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#888888]">Loading chats...</p>
              ) : historyError ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-300">{historyError}</p>
              ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-[#777777]">
                  Your saved conversations will appear here.
                </p>
              ) : (
                conversations.map((conversation) => {
                  const selected = parsedConversationId === conversation.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={conversation.id}
                      className={`group flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg transition duration-200 ${
                        selected ? "bg-[#303030]" : "hover:bg-[#2a2a2a]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openConversation(conversation.id)}
                        title={conversation.title}
                        className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 text-left"
                      >
                        <span className="block truncate text-xs text-[#dddddd]">
                          {conversation.title || "New conversation"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-[#777777]">
                          {conversation.message_count} messages
                        </span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => void removeConversation(conversation.id)}
                        title="Delete conversation"
                        aria-label={`Delete ${conversation.title || "conversation"}`}
                        className="mr-1 rounded-lg p-2 text-[#777777] opacity-100 transition hover:bg-[#414141] hover:text-red-300 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100"
                      >
                        <X size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SIDEBAR FOOTER */}

          <div className="mt-auto">
            <div
              className={`mb-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-4 ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[#eeeeee]">
                <Sparkles size={16} />

                <span className="text-xs font-bold">
                  YOUR MARKET GUIDE
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="mb-3 text-xs leading-5 text-[#a0a0a0]">
                Learn the market one question at a time.
              </p>

              <button
                onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                className="w-full rounded-lg bg-[#eeeeee] py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
              >
                Start a conversation
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => handleNavigation("Settings")}
              title={sidebarCollapsed ? "Settings" : undefined}
              className={`flex w-full items-center rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-sm text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-white ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"
              }`}
            >
              <Settings size={18} />

              <span className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                Settings
              </span>
            </button>

            <div
              className={`mt-3 flex items-center border-t border-[#303030] pt-4 ${
                sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:justify-center" : "gap-3"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#383838] text-sm font-bold text-white">
                GS
              </div>

              <div className={sidebarCollapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                  Market Explorer
                </p>

                <p className="text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
                  Beginner level
                </p>
              </div>

              {!sidebarCollapsed && (
                <ChevronDown
                  className="ml-auto text-[#888888]"
                  size={15}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* MAIN CONTENT */}

        <section className="min-w-0 flex-1">

          {/* TOP HEADER: HIDDEN ON ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav !== "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-[76px] items-center justify-between border-b border-[#303030] bg-[#000000]/95 px-4 backdrop-blur-xl md:px-7">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                {/* MOBILE SIDEBAR TOGGLE */}

                <button
                  onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
                  className="rounded-lg p-2 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white lg:hidden"
                  aria-label="Open sidebar"
                  title="Open sidebar"
                >
                  <Menu size={20} />
                </button>

                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                    {currentNav}
                  </p>

                  <p className="hidden text-[11px] text-[#888888] sm:block">
                    Your personal Indian stock market learning space
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#2a2a2a] px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] sm:flex">
                  <Search size={15} />

                  Search stocks

                  <span className="text-[#777777]">âŒ˜ K</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  aria-label="Notifications"
                  className="rounded-xl border border-[#414141] p-2.5 text-[#a0a0a0] transition hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <Bell size={17} />
                </button>

                <div className="hidden h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#383838] text-xs font-bold text-white sm:flex">
                  GS
                </div>
              </div>
            </header>
          ) : (
            /* MOBILE MENU ACCESS FOR ASK GREEDY */

            <button
              onClick={toggleMobileMenu}
              aria-label="Open sidebar"
              className="fixed left-3 top-3 z-30 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#303030] text-white shadow-lg lg:hidden"
            >
              {mobileMenu ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
            </button>
          )}

          {/* ASK GREEDY */}

          {currentNav === "Ask GREEDY" ? (
            <AskGreedyChat
              key={`ask-greedy-chat-${parsedConversationId ?? "new"}`}
              initialQuestion={questionFromUrl}
              initialConversationId={parsedConversationId}
              onConversationUpdated={() => void refreshConversations()}
            />
          ) : currentNav === "Explore & Discover" ? (
            <ExploreDiscover />
) : currentNav === "Portfolio Builder" ? (
            <PortfolioBuilder initialSelectedStock={stockFromUrl} />
          ) : currentNav === "Learn" ? (
            <LearnPage />
          ) : (

            /* DASHBOARD */

            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] p-5 md:p-8">

              {/* DASHBOARD HEADING */}

              <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#b0b0b0]">
                    <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#aaaaaa]" />
                    YOUR MARKET LEARNING DASHBOARD
                  </div>

                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee] md:text-3xl">
                    Understand the market.{" "}
                    <span className="text-[#999999]">
                      Think smarter.
                    </span>
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#999999]">
                    Explore NIFTY 50, discover opportunities and learn investing.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
                >
                  <MessageSquare size={16} />
                  Ask GREEDY
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* DATA NOTICE */}

              <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#555044] bg-[#302d25] p-3.5">
                <Activity
                  className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#e2c98a]"
                  size={17}
                />

                <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-[#d4c9ae]">
                  <strong className="text-[#f0d99e]">
                    Prototype preview:
                  </strong>{" "}
                  All market values and chart points on this screen are illustrative
                  sample data, not live market prices or investment recommendations.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* MARKET CARDS */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <MarketCard
                  label="NIFTY 50"
                  value="22,680.40"
                  change="+1.24%"
                  positive
                  icon={<TrendingUp size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="SENSEX"
                  value="74,512.30"
                  change="+0.86%"
                  positive
                  icon={<Activity size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="MARKET MOOD"
                  value="Positive"
                  change="Illustrative"
                  positive
                  icon={<Sparkles size={18} />}
                />

                <MarketCard
                  label="DATA STATUS"
                  value="Sample data"
                  change="Not live"
                  positive={false}
                  icon={<ShieldCheck size={18} />}
                />
              </div>

              {/* CHART AND GUIDE */}

              <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 xl:grid-cols-3">

                {/* NIFTY CHART */}

                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 xl:col-span-2">
                  <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                        NIFTY 50 Overview
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999999]">
                        Illustrative index movement
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-[#171717] p-1">
                      {periods.map((period) => (
                        <button
                          key={period}
                          onClick={() => setActivePeriod(period)}
                          className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition ${
                            activePeriod === period
                              ? "bg-[#eeeeee] text-[#171717]"
                              : "text-[#999999] hover:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {period}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mb-4">
                    <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
                      22,680.40
                    </span>

                    <span className="ml-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#75b798]">
                      +278.20 (+1.24%)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="h-[260px] w-full">
                    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                      <AreaChart data={chartData}>
                        <defs>
                          <linearGradient
                            id="marketGradient"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="0"
                            y2="1"
                          >
                            <stop
                              offset="0%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0.22}
                            />

                            <stop
                              offset="95%"
                              stopColor="#b0b0b0"
                              stopOpacity={0}
                            />
                          </linearGradient>
                        </defs>

                        <CartesianGrid
                          stroke="#ffffff"
                          strokeOpacity={0.07}
                          vertical={false}
                        />

                        <XAxis
                          dataKey="day"
                          axisLine={false}
                          tickLine={false}
                          tick={{ fill: "#999999", fontSize: 11 }}
                          dy={10}
                        />

                        <YAxis
                          domain={["dataMin - 150", "dataMax + 150"]}
                          orientation="right"
                          axisLine={false}
                          tickLine={false}
                          tick={{ fill: "#999999", fontSize: 10 }}
                          width={55}
                        />

                        <Tooltip
                          contentStyle={{
                            background: "#303030",
                            border: "1px solid #555555",
                            borderRadius: "10px",
                            color: "#fff",
                            fontSize: "12px",
                          }}
                        />

                        <Area
                          type="monotone"
                          dataKey="value"
                          stroke="#bdbdbd"
                          strokeWidth={2.5}
                          fill="url(#marketGradient)"
                          activeDot={{ r: 5, fill: "#eeeeee" }}
                        />
                      </AreaChart>
                    </ResponsiveContainer>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-[#888888]">
                    Sample chart Â· Period selector is a UI preview; data is not
                    connected to a market feed.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* GREEDY GUIDE */}

                <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#414141] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5">
                  <div className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-white/[0.03] blur-3xl" />

                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="mb-5 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#383838] text-[#eeeeee]">
                      <Sparkles size={22} />
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs font-bold tracking-widest text-[#bdbdbd]">
                      YOUR MARKET GUIDE
                    </p>

                    <h3 className="mt-3 text-xl font-bold leading-7 text-[#eeeeee]">
                      The market can be complicated. Learning doesn&apos;t have to be.
                    </h3>

                    <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-6 text-[#a0a0a0]">
                      Ask questions about stocks, NIFTY 50, financial concepts
                      and investment research in simple language.
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-6 space-y-2">
                      {[
                        "What is NIFTY 50?",
                        "How do I analyse a stock?",
                        "Explain risk in simple words",
                      ].map((question) => (
                        <button
                          key={question}
                          onClick={() => {
                            router.push(
                              `/?question=${encodeURIComponent(question)}`
                            );
                          }}
                          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-[#414141] bg-[#171717] px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs text-[#d0d0d0] transition hover:bg-[#2a2a2a] hover:text-white"
                        >
                          {question}

                          <ArrowUpRight
                            size={14}
                            className="text-[#aaaaaa]"
                          />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleNavigation("Ask GREEDY")}
                      className="mt-5 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#eeeeee] py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#171717] transition hover:bg-white"
                    >
                      <MessageSquare size={16} />
                      Start learning
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* STOCK WATCHLIST */}

              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                      Stock Watchlist Preview
                    </h3>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#999999]">
                      Selected NIFTY 50 companies Â· Sample values
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleNavigation("Explore & Discover")}
                    className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#d0d0d0] hover:text-white"
                  >
                    Explore all
                    <ArrowUpRight className="ml-1 inline" size={13} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[500px] text-left">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-[#414141] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[#999999]">
                        <th className="pb-3 font-medium">Company</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-medium">Symbol</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 text-right font-medium">
                          Sample price (â‚¹)
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 text-right font-medium">
                          Sample change
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {stocks.map((stock) => (
                        <tr
                          key={stock.symbol}
                          className="border-b border-[#303030] last:border-0"
                        >
                          <td className="py-4 text-xs font-semibold text-[#eeeeee]">
                            <button
                              onClick={() =>
                                router.push(`/companies/${stock.symbol}`)
                              }
                              className="text-left transition hover:text-white hover:underline"
                              title={`View ${stock.name} company profile`}
                            >
                              {stock.name}
                            </button>
                          </td>

                          <td className="py-4 text-xs text-[#999999]">
                            {stock.symbol}
                          </td>

                          <td className="py-4 text-right text-xs font-medium text-[#eeeeee]">
                            {stock.price}
                          </td>

                          <td
                            className={`py-4 text-right text-xs font-semibold ${
                              stock.positive
                                ? "text-[#75b798]"
                                : "text-[#e18b8b]"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              {stock.positive ? (
                                <ArrowUpRight size={13} />
                              ) : (
                                <ArrowDownRight size={13} />
                              )}

                              {stock.change}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* FOOTER */}

              <footer className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[10px] text-[#777777]">
                <span>
                  GREEDY STOCKS Â· Learn. Analyse. Understand.
                </span>

                <span>
                  Educational prototype Â· Not investment advice
                </span>
              </footer>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// REUSABLE MARKET CARD
// --------------------------------------------------

function MarketCard({
  label,
  value,
  change,
  positive,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  change: string;
  positive: boolean;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[#303030] bg-[#1a1a1a] p-5 transition hover:border-[#555555]">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-[#999999]">
          {label}
        </p>

        <span className="text-[#aaaaaa]">{icon}</span>
      </div>

      <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#eeeeee]">
        {value}
      </p>

      <p
        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
          positive ? "text-[#75b798]" : "text-[#d5b477]"
        }`}
      >
        {change}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"""Read-only source-code knowledge layer for Ask GREEDY."""
from pathlib import Path
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger("greedy_stocks_chat.knowledge")

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ANALYTICS = ROOT / "analytics"

# Only trusted project source directories and explicit analytical modules.
MAX_FILES = 14
MAX_FILE_CHARS = 6500
MAX_TOTAL_CHARS = 28000

EXACT_FILES = [
    "greedy_v2_engine.py",
    "greedy_v2_data.py",
    "greedy_v2_splits.py",
    "financial_metrics.py",
    "portfolio_analytics.py",
    "portfolio_allocation.py",
]

def discover_sources():
    found = {}

    for name in EXACT_FILES:
        path = ANALYTICS / name
        if path.is_file():
            found[path.resolve()] = path

    # Discover versioned implementations without assuming their names.
    for path in ANALYTICS.rglob("*.py"):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        low = path.name.lower()
        if "greedy" in low and any(x in low for x in ("v1", "v2", "v3", "engine", "algorithm")):
            found[path.resolve()] = path

    # Also discover Greedy-named backend algorithm modules.
    backend = ROOT / "backend"
    if backend.exists():
        for path in backend.glob("*greedy*.py"):
            if path.is_file():
                found[path.resolve()] = path

    return sorted(found.values(), key=lambda p: str(p).lower())[:MAX_FILES]

def build_greedy_knowledge_context(question=""):
    """Return bounded source excerpts; never execute source code."""
    pieces = []
    total = 0

    for path in discover_sources():
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        except (OSError, UnicodeError) as exc:
            logger.warning("Could not read algorithm source %s: %s", path.name, exc)
            continue

        # Keep context bounded and avoid exposing unrelated oversized modules.
        excerpt = text[:MAX_FILE_CHARS]
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        block = (
            f"\n--- SOURCE FILE: {relative} ---\n"
            f"{excerpt}\n"
            f"--- END SOURCE FILE: {relative} ---\n"
        )

        if total + len(block) > MAX_TOTAL_CHARS:
            break

        pieces.append(block)
        total += len(block)

    if not pieces:
        return (
            "GREEDY SOURCE STATUS: No matching algorithm source files were found. "
            "Do not invent version-specific implementation details."
        )

    return (
        "GREEDY STOCKS SOURCE-CODE KNOWLEDGE\n"
        "The following excerpts are read-only project source files. "
        "Use them as evidence when explaining algorithm implementation.\n"
        "Do not claim a version exists unless its source is present. "
        "Do not infer undocumented behaviour. If a file is truncated, "
        "say the available excerpt does not establish the missing detail.\n"
        + "".join(pieces)
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger("greedy_v2_evidence")
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ARTIFACTS = ROOT / "database" / "processed" / "analytics"

FILES = {
    "experiment": "greedy_v2_experiment.json",
    "baseline": "greedy_v2_baseline_comparison.json",
    "selection": "greedy_v2_selection_log.csv",
    "walk_results": "greedy_walk_forward_results.csv",
    "walk_selections": "walk_forward_selections.csv",
    "walk_report": "walk_forward_clean_report.json",
    "oos_summary": "greedy_out_of_sample_summary.csv",
}

STOPWORDS = {
    "ANALYSE", "ANALYSIS", "SHOW", "GIVE", "WHAT", "WHICH",
    "ABOUT", "STOCK", "SHARES", "GREEDY", "NIFTY", "INDIA",
    "SHARPE", "RATIO", "RETURN", "RETURNS", "VOLATILITY",
    "DRAWDOWN", "SELECTED", "SELECTION", "PORTFOLIO",
    "HISTORICAL", "PERFORMANCE", "EXPLAIN", "WHY", "WAS",
    "THE", "FOR", "AND", "WITH", "FROM", "LAST", "YEAR",
    "YEARS", "MONTH", "MONTHS", "1Y", "3M", "6M", "10Y",
}


def _read_json(name):
    path = ARTIFACTS / name
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def _read_csv(name):
    path = ARTIFACTS / name
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def _symbol_tokens(value):
    if value is None:
        return set()
    text = str(value).upper()
    return set(re.findall(r"(?<![A-Z0-9])[A-Z][A-Z0-9&._-]{1,19}(?![A-Z0-9])", text))


def _contains_symbol(row, symbol):
    for value in row.values():
        if symbol in _symbol_tokens(value):
            return True
    return False


def _question_symbol(question, known_symbols):
    tokens = _symbol_tokens(question)
    matches = sorted(tokens.intersection(known_symbols))
    if len(matches) == 1:
        return matches[0]
    if len(matches) > 1:
        return None
    candidates = [
        token for token in tokens
        if token not in STOPWORDS and not token.isdigit()
    ]
    return candidates[0] if len(candidates) == 1 else None


def _compact_rows(rows, limit=12):
    return rows[:limit]


def build_greedy_v2_evidence_context(question):
    """Read-only evidence from saved Greedy V2 experiment artifacts."""
    try:
        experiment = _read_json(FILES["experiment"])
        baseline = _read_json(FILES["baseline"])
        walk_report = _read_json(FILES["walk_report"])
        selection_rows = _read_csv(FILES["selection"])
        walk_rows = _read_csv(FILES["walk_selections"])
        walk_results = _read_csv(FILES["walk_results"])
        oos_rows = _read_csv(FILES["oos_summary"])

        known = set()
        for row in selection_rows:
            for key in ("symbol", "selected_symbol"):
                known.update(_symbol_tokens(row.get(key)))
        if isinstance(experiment, dict):
            known.update(_symbol_tokens(experiment.get("selected_symbols", [])))
        for row in walk_rows:
            for key in ("symbol", "selected_symbol", "selected_stocks", "selected_symbols"):
                known.update(_symbol_tokens(row.get(key)))

        symbol = _question_symbol(question or "", known)

        selected_rows = [
            row for row in selection_rows
            if symbol and _contains_symbol(row, symbol)
        ]

        def row_symbols(row):
            raw = row.get("symbols", "")
            return {
                item.strip().upper()
                for item in str(raw).split(",")
                if item.strip()
            }

        # Only GREEDY_V2 rows count as Greedy V2 walk-forward selections.
        fold_rows = [
            row for row in walk_rows
            if symbol
            and str(row.get("strategy", "")).strip().upper() == "GREEDY_V2"
            and symbol in row_symbols(row)
        ]

        comparison_rows = [
            row for row in walk_rows
            if symbol
            and str(row.get("strategy", "")).strip().upper() != "GREEDY_V2"
            and symbol in row_symbols(row)
        ]

        metric_by_fold = {}
        for row in walk_results:
            if str(row.get("strategy", "GREEDY_V2")).strip().upper() == "GREEDY_V2":
                metric_by_fold[str(row.get("fold", ""))] = row

        matching_fold_metrics = [
            metric_by_fold[str(row.get("fold", ""))]
            for row in fold_rows
            if str(row.get("fold", "")) in metric_by_fold
        ]


        experiment_symbols = []
        if isinstance(experiment, dict):
            values = experiment.get("selected_symbols", [])
            if isinstance(values, list):
                experiment_symbols = [str(x) for x in values]

        in_main_experiment = bool(
            symbol and any(str(x).upper() == symbol for x in experiment_symbols)
        )

        result = {
            "status": "SAVED_ARTIFACTS_READ",
            "evidence_scope": "Historical saved experiment records; not a live rerun.",
            "requested_symbol": symbol,
            "experiment": experiment,
            "greedy_v2_selection_evidence": {
                "symbol_found_in_experiment_selected_symbols": in_main_experiment,
                "matching_winner_log_rows": selected_rows[:15],
                "interpretation": (
                    "A matching row records a stock selected as the winning addition at that step."
                    if selected_rows else
                    "No matching winner row was found. The selection log records winners, "
                    "not every candidate tested; absence does not prove the stock was rejected."
                ),
            },
            "walk_forward_evidence": {
                "matching_selection_rows": fold_rows[:30],
                "matching_fold_count": len(fold_rows),
                "matching_fold_metrics": matching_fold_metrics[:30],
                "other_strategy_comparison_rows": comparison_rows[:30],
            },
            "walk_forward_audit": walk_report,
            "out_of_sample_summary": oos_rows[:20],
            "random_baseline_comparison": baseline,
            "artifact_availability": {
                key: (ARTIFACTS / filename).exists()
                for key, filename in FILES.items()
            },
            "interpretation_limits": [
                "Saved selection logs show selected winners, not all rejected candidate scores.",
                "Walk-forward records describe saved historical folds, not future performance.",
                "Latest-constituent universe can introduce survivorship bias.",
                "Training selection Sharpe is not out-of-sample performance.",
                "Do not claim a stock was rejected unless a saved artifact explicitly proves it.",
                "Do not claim the algorithm was rerun; this connector only reads saved artifacts.",
            ],
        }

        if symbol is None:
            result["symbol_note"] = (
                "No unambiguous ticker was identified in the question. "
                "Ask the user for the NSE ticker if stock-specific evidence is required."
            )

        return (
            "GREEDY_V2_EVIDENCE_STATUS: SAVED_ARTIFACTS_READ\n"
            + json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str)
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        log.exception("Greedy V2 evidence lookup failed")
        return (
            "GREEDY_V2_EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNAVAILABLE\n"
            f"Reason: {type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:400]}\n"
            "Do not invent experiment results or selection evidence."
        )


# GREEDY_V2_DATE_WINDOW_FIX
_original_build_greedy_v2_evidence_context = build_greedy_v2_evidence_context

def build_greedy_v2_evidence_context(question):
    result = _original_build_greedy_v2_evidence_context(question)

    import json
    from datetime import date

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    artifact = root / "database" / "processed" / "analytics" / "greedy_v2_experiment.json"

    if not artifact.is_file():
        note = "EXPERIMENT DATE WINDOW: artifact unavailable; dates cannot be verified."
    else:
        data = json.loads(artifact.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        meta = data.get("data_metadata") or {}
        start = meta.get("actual_start_date")
        end = meta.get("actual_end_date")

        if not start or not end:
            note = "EXPERIMENT DATE WINDOW: actual dates missing from artifact."
        else:
            first = date.fromisoformat(str(start)[:10])
            last = date.fromisoformat(str(end)[:10])
            note = (
                f"VERIFIED EXPERIMENT SAMPLE: {first.isoformat()} to "
                f"{last.isoformat()} ({(last-first).days} calendar days). "
                "This is NOT a 10-year backtest. Ten years is the historical "
                "data target, not the achieved experiment coverage. "
                "Use these actual dates; never substitute today's date, "
                "artifact generation time, or walk-forward fold boundaries."
            )

    return str(result) + "\\n\\n" + note

from analytics.ask_greedy.greedy_knowledge import discover_sources, build_greedy_knowledge_context

def test_source_discovery_returns_paths():
    paths = discover_sources()
    assert isinstance(paths, list)
    assert len(paths) <= 14

def test_knowledge_context_is_bounded():
    result = build_greedy_knowledge_context("Explain Greedy V2")
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert len(result) <= 30000
    assert "GREEDY STOCKS SOURCE-CODE KNOWLEDGE" in result or "GREEDY SOURCE STATUS" in result

def test_source_files_are_project_local():
    from pathlib import Path
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    for path in discover_sources():
        assert root in path.resolve().parents
